jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Hello, hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where and how you can work

Our flagship office is in Sydney, Australia, but we've made our way from down under, to a campus in Austin, Texas which is now home to our US operations. This is a hybrid role in Austin, Texas, so you must be able to commute to our office 1-2 times a week.


About the team

Our Sales and Success (GTM) team supports Canva Enterprise, with the mission to empower every organization to design. Canva Enterprise is an AI platform with design and productivity tools that helps organizations securely and easily create, collaborate, and publish high-impact visual content at scale.

Our Customer Success group is dedicated to delivering value for Canva Enterprise customers post-sale by driving adoption, engagement + growth. The team collaborates closely with cross-functional partners to ensure ongoing customer satisfaction and is responsible for retention, renewals, and revenue growth.


About the role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager at Canva, you are a commercially minded, consultative partner to our most valuable customers in North America. You own the full post-implementation journey, guiding customers from kick-off and early adoption all the way through renewal and expansion. This is a strategic, revenue-driving role where you serve as a trusted advisor, helping customers unlock the full value of Canva's platform in service of their most important business priorities.

You will work closely with Strategic Account Executives, Implementation, Technical Account Managers, Solutions Consultants, Ecosystem Partners and other key stakeholders to deliver seamless customer experiences and maximize account value.

What you’ll do

  • Customer success management: Lead the post-sale relationship of Canva’s strategic accounts within the customer journey, including onboarding, training, adoption, and advocacy.

  • Account growth: Proactively identify and work on upsell and cross-sell opportunities in partnership with Sales by deeply understanding customer’s evolving business needs

  • Renewals: Own renewal execution and expansion strategy for a strategic book of business, directly contributing to Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) outcomes

  • Defend the customer base: Proactively diagnose risk, develop mitigation plans, and mobilize internal resources—including Implementation, Support, and Technical Account Management—to protect and grow accounts before issues escalate.

  • Partner cross-functionally across teams to advocate for customer needs, influence product roadmap, and champion best-in-class customer success practices and frameworks

What we’re looking for

  • You have a proven track record: 6+ years of Enterprise-level post-sale experience in B2B SaaS with a demonstrated history of exceeding renewal and expansion quotas. You’ve owned a book of business and can speak to your retention and growth results with specificity.

  • You are a data-driven storyteller: You use data and analytics to build compelling narratives that influence both customer decision-makers and internal stakeholders. You don’t just report metrics, you interpret them.

  • You’re Commercially minded: You think like a business owner. You don’t just manage relationships, you manage revenue. You proactively identify growth levers, negotiate strategically, and aren’t afraid of commercial accountability.

  • You’re consultative & strategic: You lead with curiosity. You ask the right questions, connect product value to business outcomes, and position yourself as an indispensable partner rather than a reactive resource.

  • You are a relationship builder: You build genuine trust at every level. You’re skilled at multi-threading, navigating complex org structures, and developing executive-level credibility that creates lasting partnerships.

  • You communicate effectively and with influence: You communicate with passion and precision. You can rally cross-functional teams, present to executives, and tailor your message to any audience.

What's in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

Here's a taste of what's on offer:

  • Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too

  • Health benefits plans to support you and your wellbeing

  • 401(k) retirement plan with company contribution

  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers

  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more

  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally

Other stuff to know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills, merit and business needs, in compliance with applicable local laws.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above - we still want to hear from you!

When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.
Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
Thanks for stopping by. We know job ads can feel a bit formulaic sometimes, but we promise Canva is anything but. If you're drawn to what we're building and you see yourself in this role, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'd Be Doing in This Role
You'll join our Strategic Account Executive team within Canva Enterprise, working with large strategic organisations to help them consolidate design, content production and collaboration under one secure, centralised account. You're fluent in German and English, and comfortable moving between both with customers and internal partners.

At the moment, this role is focused on:

  • Owning account planning — using a data-driven approach to identify and reach out to potential customers likely to benefit from Canva's products, analysing market landscapes, trends and dynamics to translate high-level plans into targeted sales activity
  • Managing pipeline and driving revenue growth — keeping pipeline, revenue forecasts and sales activity current in Salesforce for maximum efficiency and visibility
  • Leading with a customer-centric mindset — using compelling storytelling and vision transfer, presented through a creative lens, to guide customers on a journey that feels personalised and right for them
  • Being a genuine product expert — exhibiting a deep love for Canva's product and an ability to sell creative solutions that address customers' unique problems, while gathering customer feedback and market insight to help shape the Product roadmap
  • Fostering long-term relationships — building lasting partnerships both with customers and with internal cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Post-Sales, Customer Success)
  • Bringing chaos to clarity — simplifying complex situations into digestible, customer-ready stories and materials using Canva's own worksuite (presentations, docs and more)

You're Probably a Match If:

  • You're fluent in German and English, spoken and written
  • You have 5+ years of full-cycle selling experience working with medium-sized businesses through to large enterprise organisations, ideally within a technology company, with a demonstrated history of top performance
  • You have proven success managing a full sales cycle, including prospecting with a focus on new logo attainment
  • You're a pro at navigating complexity — understanding and addressing complex business challenges and crafting solutions to match
  • You've got a talent for creating detailed plans that cover all the bases within intricate organisations
  • You've got the skills to captivate an audience, especially in face-to-face meetings with multiple key stakeholders
  • You've got a track record of leading successful negotiations
  • You're comfortable navigating uncertainty and can keep up in a fast-paced environment

About the Team
You'll be joining Sales & Success, the team behind Canva's go-to-market engine, supporting Canva Enterprise with the mission to empower every organisation to design. Canva Enterprise lets organisations consolidate design, content production and collaboration tools under one secure and centralised account — from whiteboards to docs, to presentations and our AI platform Magic Studio. We work with colleagues across the board, from Product to Marketing, all in support of our sales team. As we branch out into new markets and develop fresh Enterprise solutions, we're crafting something truly unique. Together, we're redesigning work.

What's in It for You?
Canva has grown hugely over the last few years, but we're only just getting started. Here's a taste of what's on offer:

  • Equity packages — so you share in Canva's success
  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers
  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more
  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and support you personally

Other stuff to know
We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva, so even if you don't feel like your skills quite match what's listed above — we still want to hear from you!
Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

jobs.name: Motion Designer / Video Editor - Spain (12 month contract)

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Please note

  • This a hybrid role and you will be required to go into our Madrid office 2-3 days per week. 
  • 12 month contract with full time hours
  • You will be paid a day rate

 

Join the team empowering the world to design

Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, こんにちは, 你好, hallo, नमस्ते, 안녕하세요, hola, salut!

At Canva, our mission is to empower the world to design—and we’re growing fast across the globe. With over 250 million monthly active users in over 190 countries, we’re on a mission to make Canva the most loved brand in the world. To support this ambition, we’re building a world-class marketing team that’s deeply local, highly creative, and relentlessly performance-focused.

We're looking for a Motion Designer & Video Editor to set the craft bar inside our creative pod in Spain. You'll be making motion for an audience of 250 million people, and you'll see what worked in the numbers every single week along side strategists, ops experts and world-class marketers.

About the role

As the Motion Designer & Video Editor for Spain, you’ll be making the best social-first motion content in the world. Learn from how it actually lands in partnership with creative strategists and media experts to come back more informed and produce better work next week.

You'll sit inside the local growth creative pod alongside our UGC Creators, Copy Writer and Creative Operations Manager. You'll lead on Motion, be strong on edit and can bring your own strategic lens to work that works in the primary channels the world’s attention has converged to. As part of this role, you'll report to the Creative Strategist and work closely with the broader marketing and country team.

We're looking for someone who wants to be world-class at performance creative across social, YouTube and contribute to a broader high performance marketing team. You care that the work is good and that it works. You want a tight feedback loop with the numbers, you want to ship quickly and you want to be on a team where the bar is high and the cycle is short.

About the role

✨ Lead on motion, make the product feel like magic

You'll animate Canva's design and brand assets into work that demonstrates what the product does and why it matters. This is the core craft of the role: using motion to make a product millions of people already love feel even more magical. Clean, fast, performant and visually distinctive.

🎬 Make work that performs and learn from the data every week

You'll work inside sprint cycles where every piece you ship gets measured. Top performers scale; weak ones get killed. You won't be guessing, you'll have a tight feedback loop with what's actually winning in market, and you'll use it to push your craft forward sprint by sprint. The goal isn't perfect. It's the best version of the work, shipped this week, beaten next week.

🎯 Set the bar for performance creative in Spain.

Creators give us volume. You give us craft, shipping our internal concepts, remixing from a growing content library, and setting the standard for what's possible across both short-form social and YouTube ads.

📺 Build world-class YouTube assets

YouTube isn't an afterthought or a reformat of your TikTok cut. You'll treat it as its own craft, pacing, storytelling, polish, retention curves and ship work that stands up against the best paid creative on the platform. You know the difference between a YouTube ad that earns its 30 seconds and one that gets skipped.

🧠 Recut creator content with a feel for the platform

You'll take raw creator and UGC footage and turn it into native-feeling work across Meta, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and beyond. You know what a hook is, you know how to find one in messy footage, and you can ship variants without losing the thread of what made it good in the first place.

🎨 Design motion assets across performance and brand

Flex between always-on performance creative and bigger brand moments, across short-form social and longer YouTube formats. You can dial the polish up for a hero piece or the speed up for a weekly sprint, and you don't lose taste in either direction.

🤝 Support the broader marketing team

Be a flexible craft resource for lifecycle, events, partnerships and brand campaigns when they need it. From time to time that includes light graphic design work, you're not precious about stepping outside the title.

🤖 Push the modern toolset hard

You're already experimenting with AI and modern motion tooling, using it to speed up the boring work so you can spend more time on the parts that matter. You stay across what's new, you try things, and you bring the best of it back to the team.

You’re probably a match if you have:

  • 3–5 years of motion design experience with a portfolio that shows real shipped work across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. Short-form and longer-form formats that you can talk to from concept ideation through to results.

  • Strong fluency in After Effects or Cavalry. You can take a brief from concept to delivery on your own with Motion Design as core to your craft.

  • Solid video editing in CapCut, Canva Video and/or Premiere Pro. You're not aiming to be a world-class editor, but you're reliably good and you understand the social-first cut.

  • A real interest in social. You spend time on the feeds, you can tell when something is built for the platform vs ported onto it, and you have live opinions on what's working right now and why. You can craft curiosity gaps that gets attention and introduce the product seamlessly.

  • Comfort with a fast feedback loop. You see numbers on your work weekly. You're motivated rather than rattled by them, and you change direction without ego.

  • Experience editing creator content into performance-tuned social work, you know how to find the hook in raw footage.

  • Some graphic design literacy. You can step into a static asset job when the team needs it.

  • A working curiosity about AI tooling and a habit of experimenting with it in your craft.

  • Spanish and good English, with a feel for cultural resonance in local creative work.

About the team

You'll be part of a highly collaborative, fast-moving, and passionate marketing team that blends creativity and data to make magic happen. In this role, you'll help Canva show up at its best in Spain and fuel growth by bringing performance and creativity together in every campaign.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Please note this is a hybrid role and you must be based in Berlin to go into the office. 

 

The Country Design Lead plays a pivotal role in Canva’s mission to democratise design by ensuring content is truly local, culturally resonant, and of the highest design quality. Partnering closely with the Country Content Strategy Lead and cross-functional stakeholders, this role directs and delivers content – at speed and scale – that drives user engagement, content adoption, and revenue growth in Germany.

Aligned to Canva’s international growth strategy, this role ensures the creative direction, production, and curation of market-relevant content across templates and elements. The role bridges global vision with local market needs, ensuring cultural authenticity while meeting business objectives.

 

Key Responsibilities

Creative Direction

  • Develop a compelling creative vision that delivers and executes against the Country Content Strategy Lead and Country Manager’s strategic priorities.

  • Collaborate closely with local Marketing, SEO, and Community teams.

  • Translate country and regional strategies into locally relevant campaigns.

  • Drive AI adoption in production and content innovation, supporting new product formats and emerging trends to keep creative outputs fresh and competitive.

Content Creation & Curation

  • Oversee the creation of content, including design kits, campaign documents, creator briefs, and in-house production where needed.

  • Work with Freelance Copywriters and/or AI Copy to ensure copy is culturally relevant and adheres to our copy best practice standards.

  • Curate and editorially frame content for marketing initiatives, showcases, and seasonal calendars to elevate local relevance.

  • Proactively identify content gaps and curate assets that reflect strategic priorities and creative excellence.

  • Lead quality control of all content outputs, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines and maintaining high standards of visual and messaging quality.

Market Understanding & Cultural Insights

  • Build and maintain a deep knowledge of local culture, consumer behaviour, and design trends to inform content direction and strategy.

  • Conduct foundational content research, ensuring creative and editorial output aligns with strategic needs and cultural nuances.

  • Provide cultural expertise to scale content, ensuring authenticity and relevance to the local market across AICG, partnerships, and creators.

  • Champion hyperlocal design perspectives in collaboration with cross-functional teams.

  • Support building an editorial strategy for local content, ensuring Canva’s library reflects cultural relevance, diversity, and inclusive storytelling.

  • Advocate for the integration of global and underrepresented perspectives in content development and curation, upholding Canva’s commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion.

Content Performance Monitoring & Analysis

  • Conduct template and element audits to identify improvement areas and opportunities for new content.

  • Perform content performance and gap analysis, distilling insights into recommendations that guide future content creation and acquisition.

  • Leverage data, trends, and local insights to shape creative direction, enhance creator and in-house briefs, and inform design decisions.

  • Facilitate retrospectives and performance reviews to refine strategies and content effectiveness.

  • Actively raise discoverability challenges or product limitations that impact content visibility or engagement.

Partnership & Stakeholder Management

  • Partner closely with Country Content Strategy Lead, as well as collaborate with local SEO, Marketing, and Country Managers – to align on creative goals and content needs, and confidently prioritise and negotiate trade-offs.

  • Lead the rollout of local partnership content through culturally relevant creative strategies and campaigns.

  • Manage creative strategy, brand adherence, and feedback implementation to meet partner expectations and project goals.

  • Communicate initiatives and results to senior leadership, ensuring visibility across stakeholders.

Competitive Analysis

  • Monitor competitor activity and creative trends across the region to identify new opportunities and maintain strategic edge.

  • Use findings to inform the content roadmap and differentiate Canva's creative offerings in the local market.

Project Management

  • Monitor project execution, mitigate risks, and escalate challenges when necessary to ensure timely, high-quality outcomes.

  • Maintain visibility into campaign timelines and production volume goals across all creative operations.

  • Maintain an agile mindset and adapt quickly to shifting priorities and dynamic day-to-day needs.

Freelance & Creator Management

  • Oversee local freelance designers, managing recruitment, briefing, output review, and development.

  • Build strong relationships with the Creators Production and Community teams, providing hyperlocal direction through well-crafted briefs and feedback loops.

  • Champion Creator-led content that resonates deeply with local audiences and reflects cultural authenticity.

Reporting & Communication

  • Report on the performance and ROI of creative campaigns, using analytics to guide and improve future content plans and outputs.

  • Keep senior management and regional stakeholders informed about key initiatives, learnings, and creative progress.

  • Ensure alignment and transparency through consistent documentation and communication.

Feedback & Quality Assurance

  • Provide timely feedback and approvals across creative workstreams, maintaining alignment with both business goals and creative standards.

  • Drive internal reviews and uphold quality benchmarks for all deliverables across content types.

Team Building & Culture

  • Contribute to and foster a collaborative, innovative, and high-performing regional creative team culture.

  • Promote continuous improvement through process optimization, retrospectives, and shared best practices.

  • Encourage creative excellence while ensuring inclusion, psychological safety, and alignment across diverse teams.

 

What you'll be doing

The Country Design Lead will join the International Content Team, whose mission is to build the most valuable content library in the world. The team sits within the International Supergroup and partners closely with Content & Discovery, Marketing, SEO, and other in-market teams to unlock content-driven growth through high-quality, locally relevant templates and elements across graphics, photos, and video.

The team is focused on delivering content that is truly local at scale – ensuring everything published meets Canva’s standards for design craft, cultural resonance, and user value, while leveraging AI and scalable systems to increase speed and impact.


This role is responsible for driving the creative execution of content for the German market, translating strategy into high-performing outputs that reflect local culture, behaviours, and trends. Working in close partnership with the Country Manager, Country Content Strategy Lead, and cross-functional stakeholders, the Country Design Lead plays a key role in delivering content that drives engagement, adoption, and growth.

Operating as a hands-on builder and AI-native operator, this role leads the creation and curation of locally relevant content across both elements (graphics, photos, video) and templates spanning social media, presentations, websites, and print. This includes leveraging AI to accelerate production, and continuously improving quality and performance through rapid iteration.

This role will also direct a team of local creatives to curate and elevate impactful, truly local content across both elements — such as graphics, photos, and videos — and templates spanning social media, presentations, websites, and print products. By fostering a culture of excellence and innovation, this role will play a vital part in achieving Canva’s mission of delivering a world-class, truly local design experience.

You will: 

  • Operate with high ownership and autonomy while collaborating across multiple teams, functions, and time zones

  • Work at pace, balancing speed and quality, and adapting quickly to shifting priorities and evolving business needs

  • Leverage AI tools and workflows to scale content production and improve efficiency

  • Build and optimise repeatable systems for content creation, rather than one-off outputs

  • Maintain clear, proactive communication with stakeholders and drive alignment across teams

  • Lead creative reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement loops

  • Foster a high-performance team culture grounded in inclusion, psychological safety, and a bias for action

 

What we're looking for: 

We’re looking for a high-performing design leader who combines strong creative craft with a builder mindset. You are culturally attuned, globally aware, and obsessed with creating content that feels truly local – and drives business results. You’ll be excited to join an A-player team committed to growing Canva in in your [locale].


You bring a sharp eye for design, but more importantly, you know how to deliver quality at speed. You operate with an AI-first mindset, using tools and systems to generate, iterate, and scale content efficiently – without compromising on craft.


You thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments and are comfortable working with evolving tools, shifting priorities, and imperfect information. You’re proactive, pragmatic, and outcome-focused—someone who takes ownership, moves quickly, and continuously looks for better ways of working.


You’re collaborative and low ego, able to partner effectively with Content Strategy, Marketing, SEO, and Product teams – translating strategic direction into content execution and driving alignment through clarity and action. You’re equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves to deliver work as you are guiding and uplifting others.

You’ll have:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Design, Marketing, Communications, or a related field

  • Proven experience in creative leadership roles, ideally with international, regional, or market-level remit

  • A strong portfolio showcasing exceptional design work and content campaigns that reflect cultural resonance and local user needs

  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (SEO, Growth, Marketing, Product)

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and storytelling skills

  • A results-focused mindset, balancing creative innovation with business and user goals

  • Experience managing freelancers and/or creators, with a focus on quality and alignment

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with an experimentation mindset

 

To apply, please submit: 

  • Updated CV 
  • More recent portfolio

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time-consuming, and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where and how you can work

Our flagship Sydney campus is uniquely Canva - an extension of our Surry Hills neighbourhood. It’s a thoughtfully designed space with plenty of room to collaborate, focus, and connect. This role is based in Sydney, and we’re looking for someone who calls it home. Our hybrid way of working gives you the flexibility to work remotely, and to come together on campus for meaningful in-person collaboration and connection when it matters most. We trust our Canvanauts to choose the balance that empowers them and their team to achieve their goals.

What you'd be doing in this role

As Canva scales, change remains part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. This will give you a flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.

At the moment, this role is focused on:

  • Develop and maintain high-performance C++ services, frameworks, and tools that power Canva's audio and video processing platform.
  • Design and implement distributed systems that efficiently ingest, process, store, and deliver multimedia content to millions of users globally.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and designers to enable exceptional video editing and playback experiences across Canva.
  • Optimise multimedia processing pipelines for reliability, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Build new platform capabilities that support Canva's rapidly growing video and multimedia ecosystem.
  • Drive engineering excellence through testing, code reviews, operational best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Troubleshoot complex production challenges and contribute to the long-term evolution of Canva's video infrastructure.

You're probably a match if

• You have strong commercial experience building highly scalable, secure, and performant backend systems using C++.
• You're deeply grounded in computer science and software engineering fundamentals, including concurrency, multithreading, memory management, data structures, architecture, and design patterns.
• You have experience designing and operating distributed systems and scalable backend architectures.
• You have hands-on experience working with cloud platforms and services in production environments.
• You are highly skilled at diagnosing, debugging, and resolving complex performance and reliability issues.
• You have excellent communication and collaboration skills and enjoy working across engineering, product, and design teams.
• You are passionate about audio and video technologies and excited by the challenge of processing multimedia content at a massive scale.
• You have experience with modern video codecs such as H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC, VP9, or AV1.
• You have deep experience with multimedia frameworks and libraries such as FFmpeg and/or GStreamer, including source-level debugging, architecture analysis, performance profiling, and custom patch development.

• You have a strong understanding of multimedia containers and formats such as MP4 and WebM.

• Contributions to FFmpeg, GStreamer, or other open-source multimedia projects.
• Experience optimising video playback through adaptive bitrate streaming technologies such as DASH, HLS, or CMAF.
• Experience tuning encoding pipelines to improve video quality, storage efficiency, and delivery performance.

Where and how you can work

Our flagship Sydney campus is uniquely Canva - an extension of our Surry Hills neighbourhood. It’s a thoughtfully designed space with plenty of room to collaborate, focus, and connect.

Collingwood is home to our Melbourne campus - a vibrant, creative hub for connection and impactful work.

This role is based in Sydney or Melbourne. Our hybrid way of working gives you the flexibility to work remotely, and to come together on campus for meaningful in-person collaboration and connection when it matters most. What you'd be doing in this role

jobs.name: Copy of Principal Software Engineer - Mobile Platform

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
***Role requires relocation to Australia, with work visa and relocation package provided***

Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

What you’d be doing in this role

Mobile Platform owns how Canva runs on iOS and Android. Every product team at Canva builds on top of what this group ships. Hundreds of millions of users open Canva on a phone or tablet, and the architecture that powers that experience is one of the most important technical bets the company is making right now.

Today, much of Canva’s mobile product runs as a web application inside a native app shell. We’re moving towards a hybrid architecture built around React and React Native, supported by native iOS and Android capabilities, portable libraries and shared mobile infrastructure.

The ambition is simple to describe and difficult to execute: build once, ship native-feeling experiences across iOS, Android and web.

React Native is the direction we’re taking, but this role is bigger than expertise in a single framework. We’re also interested in Principal-level engineers who have solved comparable problems through Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform or other production-scale cross-platform architectures, and are excited to transfer that expertise into what we’re building.

This is a genuinely rare problem: evolving a mature mobile architecture while the product remains live for hundreds of millions of users and hundreds of engineers continue building on top of it. The decisions made here will shape how Canva builds mobile for the next decade.

At the moment, this role is focused on:

  • Set the technical direction: Own the key architectural decisions for Canva’s hybrid mobile platform across React Native, iOS and Android, including what should be shared, what should remain native, and how those layers work together.

  • Get the new platform into production: In your first few months, you’ll turn the architecture into shipped code, with the foundations for performance, reliability and observability in place.

  • Prove it on a real product surface: Within six months, the goal is to have a React Native surface live in production, supported by stable capabilities and platform primitives that feature teams can build on.

  • Lead senior engineers through the migration: Be the architectural anchor for Staff and Senior engineers across Mobile Platform, helping them navigate difficult technical decisions as the new platform takes shape.

  • Scale adoption across Canva: In the new year, work with major product teams moving onto the platform, establishing patterns engineers trust and choose to use. Over time, you’ll become one of Canva’s technical voices on mobile architecture, with decisions influencing 800+ frontend engineers.

You're probably a match if...
We'd love to hear from you if you fit one or more of these. You don't need to meet all of them, but the more the better and if you join the team, we're invested in helping you grow.

Experience

  • Cross-platform architecture at scale: Built or significantly evolved a large-scale cross-platform mobile architecture in production. React Native and React are highly relevant, but deep experience with Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform or another production-scale cross-platform stack can also be compelling.

  • Migration at scale: Led a meaningful migration of a mature mobile product onto a new architecture while it remained live and growing. The stronger signal is changing an existing system at scale, rather than starting clean.

  • Principal-level technical leadership: Set technical direction across multiple teams where the answer wasn’t obvious, brought senior engineers and leaders with you, and had Staff-level engineers building against the direction you established.

  • Organisation-wide influence: You’ve shaped architecture beyond your immediate team, creating platforms, standards or technical direction adopted across multiple groups or a large engineering organisation.

  • Hands-on technical depth: You’re still close to the code and comfortable working through hard implementation details, not just setting direction from a distance.

  • Engineering judgement: You don’t need to arrive as a React Native evangelist. You do need to reason from first principles, challenge assumptions constructively and help make Canva’s chosen architecture successful at scale.

Technical knowledge

  • Mobile runtime: Shared-code runtimes, native boundaries, bundle delivery and performance profiling on real devices

  • iOS and Android: Deep fundamentals across both platforms and a strong instinct for where shared abstractions stop making sense

  • Mobile performance: Performance, reliability, crash monitoring and optimisation at scale

  • Platform architecture: Shared capabilities, libraries, abstractions and infrastructure used across multiple engineering teams

  • Deep fundamentals: Strong engineering fundamentals, including data structures, complexity and system-level trade-offs

Nice to have

  • React Native at scale: Deep production experience with React Native and React internals

  • System languages: Rust or C/C++ for portable libraries that run across mobile platforms

  • Open-source contributions: React Native, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform, Expo or the wider cross-platform mobile ecosystem

  • Mobile CI/CD: Release trains and over-the-air updates at scale

  • AI fluency: You’ve used AI tooling in real engineering work and have a view on how it changes the way mobile teams build and operate software.

About the team

You'll be joining our Client Platform group at Canva, where our mission is to ensure a delightful experience for every user on every device. Client Platform owns the foundations that every product team builds on, including Web Platform, Mobile Platform, and the user-facing surfaces of the product. Hundreds of millions of users sit on top of what this group ships. Every Canva product runs on it.

Mobile Platform is the group inside Client Platform responsible for how Canva runs on iOS and Android. We're the team of engineers who care deeply about mobile performance, who want to shape how cross-platform mobile gets built at scale, and who want to own the next decade of how Canva runs on a phone or tablet.

The work compounds in two directions at once. Every team at Canva benefits when the mobile platform gets faster and more capable. And the architectural decisions made here will outlast most of the systems built on top of them.

What's in it for you?
Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a stack of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

Here's a taste of what's on offer:

  • Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too
  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers
  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more
  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

Other stuff to know
We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

Hundreds of millions of users sit on top of what this group ships. Every Canva product runs on it.

Mobile Platform is the group inside Client Platform responsible for how Canva runs on iOS and Android. We're the team of engineers who care deeply about mobile performance, who want to shape how cross-platform mobile gets built at scale, and who want to own the next decade of how Canva runs on a phone or tablet.

The ambition is simple to describe and difficult to execute: build once, ship native-feeling experiences across iOS, Android and web.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Hello, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.


Where and how you can work

Our flagship office is in Sydney, Australia, but we've made our way from down under, to a campus in Austin, Texas which is now home to our US operations. This is a hybrid role in Austin, Texas, so you must be able to commute to our office 2 times a week. 
 

About the Team

At Canva, our Higher Education Account Executive team is dedicated to helping educational institutions of all kinds create stunning visual content that inspires and engages students. Our team consists of experienced sales consultants who have a passion for education and a deep understanding of the unique needs and challenges of higher education institutions.

Our Account Executives collaborate closely with colleges and universities to understand how they teach, communicate, and connect. We offer solutions that help faculty share content more easily, help marketing teams reach future students, and help every department create visuals that support learning and growth.

We are committed to building long-term relationships with our customers and providing exceptional customer service every step of the way to help you take higher education institutions to the next level.


About the Role

As a Higher Education Account Executive at Canva, you’ll own our Scaled Higher Education portfolio across the U.S. market, supporting universities with fewer than 5,000 students. You’ll be responsible for driving growth across a broad portfolio of institutions, identifying opportunities to expand Canva’s presence and helping universities adopt and scale the platform across their campuses.

Partnering closely with Customer Success, you’ll manage the university lifecycle from initial engagement and onboarding through adoption, retention, and expansion. You’ll use data and user insights to prioritize opportunities across your territory, build scalable growth strategies, and engage administrators, faculty, and other key stakeholders to drive meaningful adoption.

This role combines high-volume portfolio management with strategic selling. You’ll balance opportunities across the U.S. market, exceed revenue targets, and help establish Canva as a trusted partner for higher education institutions throughout the region.


What you'll do 

As Canva scales, change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. This will give you a flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.

At the moment, this role is focused on:

  • Own the Scaled Higher Education business across the U.S. market. You'll own the strategy, planning, execution, and results for a portfolio of universities with fewer than 5,000 students, identifying and prioritizing opportunities to drive adoption, growth, and revenue across the region.
  • Manage and grow a broad portfolio of universities. You'll build relationships with key university stakeholders and develop scalable sales approaches that enable you to effectively engage and grow multiple institutions across your territory.
  • Drive university-wide adoption. You'll work with administrators, faculty, and other stakeholders to demonstrate Canva's value, navigate the buying process, and support successful deployments across departments, faculty, and students.
  • Build a healthy and predictable business. You'll manage your pipeline and portfolio with a strong understanding of where to focus your time, balancing new opportunities with expansion across existing institutions to consistently deliver against your targets.
  • Understand the Higher Education customer. You'll develop a strong understanding of the needs, priorities, and challenges facing universities across the U.S., and use those insights to position Canva as a valuable partner for teaching, learning, communication, and collaboration.
  • Use data to identify growth opportunities. You'll leverage account, usage, and market insights to prioritize institutions, uncover expansion opportunities, and inform your sales strategy.
  • Partner cross-functionally to scale impact. You'll collaborate closely with Customer Success and teams across Canva to share customer insights, improve our approach to the Higher Education market, and create repeatable strategies that can scale across the region.
     

What we're looking for

  • Experience in Higher Education or Education Technology. You understand how universities evaluate, purchase, and adopt technology and can effectively engage with stakeholders across academic and administrative teams.
  • Strong sales experience. You have experience owning a sales territory or portfolio, managing pipeline, navigating sales cycles, and consistently working toward revenue and growth targets. Experience selling SaaS, education technology, or other technology solutions is highly valued.
  • Scaled portfolio management skills. You're comfortable managing a broad book of business and know how to prioritize your time and opportunities based on customer potential, engagement, and likelihood to grow.
  • A consultative approach to selling. You can uncover customer needs, connect them to Canva's value, and build compelling business cases that resonate with different university stakeholders.
  • Understanding of technology adoption. You understand how institutions evaluate and roll out new technology and can help customers navigate the path from initial interest to broader university adoption.
  • Excellent communication skills. You create clarity by making complex ideas simple and can confidently present, influence, and tell a compelling story to customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong business planning and execution. You can translate territory and account insights into clear priorities, execute against a plan, and adapt quickly based on results.
  • Cross-functional collaboration. You enjoy working closely with Customer Success and other teams to deliver a strong customer experience and identify opportunities for growth.
  • Growth mindset. You're curious, adaptable, and eager to learn as Canva's Higher Education business continues to evolve and scale.
     

What's in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll also experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity, and fun woven throughout life at Canva. We also offer a range of benefits designed to set you up for success, both in and outside of work.

Here's a taste of what's on offer:

  • Equity packages — we want our success to be yours too
  • Health benefits plans to support you and your wellbeing
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company contribution
  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents and carers
  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup, and more
  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge, and support you personally
     

Other stuff to know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills, merit and business needs, in compliance with applicable local laws.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above - we still want to hear from you!

When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
About the role

Content moves Canva, and ensuring our content is a driver of growth is crucial. Just as we invest in strong business, marketing, sales, and product leaders in our priority markets, we need an equally strong voice in content.

As a Country Content Strategy Lead, you’ll partner closely with the Country Manager to ensure Canva has the right strategic content from your country (or countries), owning content as a growth engine and adapting strategies to support MAU, retention, and revenue impact.

You’ll work closely with the Country Design Lead to deliver content that drives business outcomes. You’ll also champion local relevance and trends that make international users feel Canva is for them, and work closely with country teams (SEO, Localisation, Creators, Product, Marketing) and regional stakeholders to ensure local content delivers high value and measurable impact.

You’ll be coached and supported by a Regional Content Strategy Lead, who will drive content strategy across the region.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
What you’ll do

As a Country Content Strategy Lead, you bring expertise in strategy, content, business management, and cross-functional stakeholder management. In particular, you will:

  • Content Strategy & Execution – Prioritise and execute country content strategy and growth levers, owning content health and production for your country to drive relevance, scale, and business impact.
  • Content Quality & Relevance – Ensure that your country’s content meets Canva’s standards, resonates culturally, and supports strategic growth metrics.
  • Feedback & Insights – Gather input from sales, partners, and local peers to refine content strategies and enhance Canva’s country impact.
  • Discovery & Performance – Own your country’s content performance across discovery, editorial ensuring the right local content is surfaced through search, recommendations, and editorial, and optimised for engagement, activation, and retention.
  • Editorial & Trends Leadership – Execute your country’s editorial strategy across surfaces (e.g. Showcases), identifying and activating cultural moments in partnership with Marketing, Social and PR.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Act as a strategic partner to Country Manager and country peers to align priorities, unblock execution, and drive content-led growth.
  • Creator & Partner Engagement – In collaboration with your country community and partnerships managers, build relationships with local creators and partnerships to activate a thriving content ecosystem.

担当業務

コンテンツストラテジーリードとして、日本市場におけるコンテンツ戦略の立案・実行から、事業管理、部門横断のステークホルダーとの連携まで、幅広くリードしていただきます。

コンテンツ戦略の立案・実行

日本市場におけるコンテンツ戦略を策定し、成長につながる施策の優先順位付けと実行をリードします。コンテンツの健全性と制作全体を管理し、関連性・拡張性・事業インパクトの向上を推進します。

コンテンツの品質・ローカル適合性の担保

日本向けコンテンツがCanvaの品質基準を満たし、日本のユーザーに文化的に響くものであること、また戦略上の成長目標に貢献することを担保します。

フィードバック・インサイトの収集と活用

セールスチームやパートナーから市場のニーズやフィードバックを収集・分析し、コンテンツ戦略の改善とCanva Japanでの事業インパクト向上につなげます。

ディスカバリー・パフォーマンスの最適化

検索、レコメンデーション、エディトリアルの観点から、日本向けコンテンツの発見性とパフォーマンスを管理します。適切なローカルコンテンツがユーザーに届き、エンゲージメント、アクティベーション、リテンションにつながるよう最適化します。

エディトリアル・トレンドのリーダーシップ

Showcasesをはじめとする各サーフェスで、日本市場向けのエディトリアル戦略を実行します。マーケティング、ソーシャル、PRチームと連携し、文化的なモーメントやトレンドを捉えた企画を推進します。

部門横断での連携

Country Managerおよび日本チームの戦略的パートナーとして、優先事項の整合を図り、実行上の課題を解消しながら、コンテンツを起点とした成長を推進します。

クリエイター・パートナーとの関係構築

日本のコミュニティチームやパートナーシップチームと連携し、現地クリエイターやパートナーとの関係構築を進め、活気あるコンテンツエコシステムの成長を支えます。

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
What we're looking for

We’re seeking a strategic thinker who thrives in fast-paced environments and can drive content impact within their market. They’ll take a pragmatic approach to content creation – working across multiple production streams (AIGC, creators, localisation, bespoke, and partnerships) to solve local content needs, improve efficiency, and scale what works.

This role requires someone who can combine strong strategic thinking with a deep understanding of their local market — translating regional direction into actionable country-level plans, and working closely with Country Design Leads to bring these to life. You should be someone who naturally gravitates toward solving problems, enjoys working with data to inform decisions, and can build strong relationships across cross-functional teams.

The ideal candidate combines analytical rigour with cultural curiosity, demonstrating both the ability to shape country-level content strategy and to identify opportunities to scale what works through repeatable approaches, AI-supported workflows, and strong partnerships.

  • 3-5+ years of experience in content strategy, regional business strategy and operations, partnerships, or similar roles within high-growth content, media or marketplace global technology companies.

  • A deep understanding of content, trends, and aesthetics in your market (or markets), with a pulse on what resonates with local users.

  • A proactive, solutions-driven approach, capable of balancing strategy with hands-on execution.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align cross-functional teams across regions.

  • Experience working in fast-moving, dynamic environments, comfortable with ambiguity and change.

  • Strong analytical skills to assess content performance and inform strategy adjustments.

  • A track record of successfully managing production workflows, partnerships, and/ or supporting and activating local creators.

  • Language skills and cultural knowledge relevant to your geographic market, with ability to work effectively across different time zones.

求める人物像

変化が速い環境の中で力を発揮し、日本市場におけるコンテンツのインパクトを高められる、戦略的かつ実行力のある方を求めています。

AIGC、クリエイター、ローカライゼーション、パートナーシップなど、複数の制作ストリームを横断しながら、日本市場のコンテンツニーズを解決していただきます。制作効率を高め、成果の出ている取り組みを拡大していくために、戦略だけでなく実務にも主体的に取り組める方を歓迎します。

このポジションには、優れた戦略的思考力と日本市場への深い理解を持ち、リージョンの方針を日本市場で実行可能なプランに落とし込み、Country Design Leadと緊密に連携しながら実現できる方が適しています。課題解決を楽しみ、データに基づいて意思決定を行い、部門を越えた信頼関係を築ける方を求めています。

理想の候補者は、分析力と文化的な好奇心を兼ね備え、日本市場に適したコンテンツ戦略を形にできる方です。また、再現性のある仕組み、AIを活用したワークフロー、強いパートナーシップを通じて、成果の出ている施策を拡大する機会を見出せる方を歓迎します。

コンテンツ戦略、リージョナルビジネス戦略・オペレーション、パートナーシップ、または関連領域で3〜5年以上の実務経験をお持ちの方

※特に、成長フェーズのコンテンツ、メディア、マーケットプレイス、グローバルテクノロジー企業での経験を歓迎します。

日本市場におけるコンテンツ、トレンド、デザインや美的感覚への深い理解があり、現地ユーザーに何が響くかを把握している方

主体的かつ課題解決志向で、戦略立案と実務の両方をバランスよく担える方

jobDescription.text:
Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where and how you can work

Our flagship office is in Sydney, Australia, but we've made our way from down under to a hub in San Francisco, which is now home to our US operations. We offer flexibility in how and where you work. We trust our Canvanauts to choose the balance that empowers them and their team to achieve their goals.

What you’d be doing in this role

As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.

We’re looking for a new Head of Commercial Legal to lead our incredible team. The Commercial Legal team is responsible for empowering Canva’s scalable growth through strategic legal and operational guidance. They structure, negotiate and manage Canva’s customer, partner and supplier agreements, supporting go-to-market efforts, new products and commercial initiatives. They’re trusted partners to the business, helping teams navigate deal-making at pace, with precision and smart risk management.
You’ll be joining a dynamic, collaborative team that is passionate about enabling Canva's mission to empower the world to design.

What you’ll do 

  • Lead and coach a high-performing global Commercial Legal team.

  • Set the vision and strategy for how Commercial Legal enables Canva’s growth while managing commercial risk.

  • Provide strategic guidance to Canva leadership on material commercial, customer, partner and supplier matters.

  • Partner closely with Sales, Procurement, Finance, Product and other teams to support launches, new business models and strategic initiatives.

  • Design scalable commercial legal processes, playbooks, templates and ways of working that help Canva move quickly and consistently.

  • Foster a high-performance, collaborative culture through thoughtful work distribution, growth and development, team wellbeing and headcount and resourcing decisions.

  • Drive team connection and culture through team rituals, including all-hands, cross-specialty engagement and the annual global Legal Summit.

  • Champion Canva’s AI Native ways of working, actively using and encouraging the use of AI tools to streamline workflows and improve the team’s impact.

  • Manage Commercial Legal budgets and outside counsel engagement.

  • Monitor market developments, emerging technologies and legal trends, translating these into clear, practical recommendations for Canva.

You're probably a match if

  • Leadership & teamwork: This team operates with a high degree of autonomy and mutual trust. We’re looking for a leader who thrives in collaborative environments. Bonus if you’ve had experience managing a team across different timezones.

  • Commercial breadth and judgment: You should bring strong experience advising on a broad range of commercial matters, including customer, partner, supplier and technology transactions. Deep expertise in one or more areas is valued, but the most important thing is the ability to navigate complex commercial issues, ask the right questions and make practical decisions.

  • Strategic business partnering: You will be a trusted adviser to senior business leaders. You should be comfortable balancing legal risk with commercial opportunity, finding workable paths forward and communicating advice clearly to both legal and non-legal stakeholders.

  • Industry context: You have experience advising technology companies, understand how legal considerations intersect with product development and go-to-market strategy and are comfortable operating amid ambiguity and change.

  • Building for scale: You have experience improving legal processes, using technology effectively and building a function that can support a growing global company without creating unnecessary friction.

  • Comfort with and fluency in AI tools: Canva Legal is on a mission to become an AI Native Legal Team. It’s important that you’re comfortable with using AI tools to help us drive AI adoption and integration into our practices.

What's in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

Here's a taste of what's on offer:

  • Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too

  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers

  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more

  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

Other stuff to know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above - we still want to hear from you!

Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Join the team changing how the world designs - billions of times over.

Ready to make a meaningful impact? You’re in the right place.

Every role at Canva is part of something bigger. Here’s what this one looks like, what we offer and why we think you’ll love it here.


Where and how you’ll work

Hybrid
While our global HQ is based in Sydney, Australia, our Manila campus has grown into a vibrant hub of creativity, connection and community.

Our Makati City campus is a space filled with warm energy and spaces to collaborate, focus, and recharge (with extra perks like a fitness studio). Coming together to connect over food has always been a huge part of our culture, so you’ll enjoy daily breakfast and lunch, prepared by our onsite chefs.

This role is based in Manila, and we’re looking for someone who calls it home. Our hybrid way of working gives you flexibility - you’ll have the option to work from home as well as connecting and collaborating with your team in-person, on campus. We trust teams to choose the balance that empowers them to achieve their goals.

 

What you’ll be working on

As Canva continues to scale across Southeast Asia, the Philippines is one of our most exciting and highest-potential markets. As Marketing Lead, you'll own the end-to-end marketing strategy for the Philippines — shaping how Canva shows up culturally, building brand love, and driving growth across a market that's uniquely vibrant, social-first, and community-driven.

You'll lead a talented team of around nine across brand, social, influencer, events, and community, and work hand-in-hand with the Growth Marketing Lead to ensure brand and performance are pulling in the same direction.

Your focus areas

  • Owning the Philippine marketing strategy end-to-end, with clear accountability for brand awareness, adoption, and affinity

  • Leading big, fame-driving brand campaigns — from strategic brief through to 360 execution across TV, digital, OOH, and social

  • Overseeing creative production and media buying, ensuring work lands with cultural impact and commercial efficiency

  • Building and managing strategic partnerships that extend Canva's reach and relevance in the Philippines

  • Leading a high-performing social team, including always-on content and influencer marketing — ensuring Canva has a distinctive, locally resonant voice across platforms

  • Driving community impact through events, trainings, and initiatives that build genuine brand love on the ground

  • Collaborating closely with the Growth Marketing Lead on CRM and performance marketing, ensuring integrated thinking across the full funnel

  • Leading, coaching, and growing a team, creating a culture of ambition, creativity, and accountability

You'll thrive in this role if

  • You are a resilient, tenacious marketing leader who thrives in fast-moving environments and knows how to build brands that people genuinely love.

  • You have extensive marketing experience, with a strong track record of leading brand-building and growth initiatives in the Philippines or comparable high-growth markets

  • You have experience owning big, integrated brand campaigns from strategy through execution — you understand what it takes to create fame, not just awareness

  • You have a background in or deep familiarity with high-growth companies — you're comfortable with pace, ambiguity, and building as you go

  • You are a proven people leader who can coach, develop, and inspire a multi-disciplinary team

  • You have a strong grasp of the Philippines' digital and cultural landscape — you know which platforms matter, which voices carry weight, and what makes Filipinos stop scrolling

  • You have experience across paid media, partnerships, influencer, and community, with the ability to connect dots across channels

  • You are collaborative by nature — you work well across functions and can build strong relationships with Growth, Product, and regional teams

  • You are based in Manila, with fluency in English; Taglish and other Philippine languages or dialects are a genuine advantage

  • You are flexible, positive, and energised by a challenge — you bring the kind of personality that lifts a team even on the hard days

 

Meet the team

You'll be joining Canva's Philippine marketing team — a close-knit group covering brand, social, influencer, events and community. It's a team that's grown organically, built by people who care deeply about the market and the work, and it's ready for someone to bring it together under one clear direction while keeping the energy and creativity that got it here.

You'll report directly to our Philippine Country Manager, working side by side to shape what Canva's brand looks and feels like in one of our most important Southeast Asian markets. This is a genuinely high-visibility seat at the table — the kind of role where your fingerprints will be on how millions of Filipinos come to know and love Canva.

 

Why you’ll love it here

We’re on a mission to empower the world to design, and we believe that if we get this right, we can do the most good we can in the world. And we're just getting started.

You’ll do interesting work that motivates you, experience moments that surprise you, and collaborate with people who inspire you to do the best work of your life every day.

And because doing your best work starts with feeling supported, we offer benefits designed with you in mind.

Here’s a peek at what we offer:

  • Equity packages so our success is yours too

  • Inclusive parental leave that supports all parents and carers

  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup and more

  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and show up as your best self

Discover more at lifeatcanva.com

How we think about AI

AI is an accelerant to our mission to empower the world to design. We’re embracing it as a powerful tool to help us move faster, spark ideas, streamline work, and unlock creativity.

We’re genuinely curious about how people are thinking about and experimenting with new technologies to amplify impact, so you can expect it to come up in conversation during the interview process.

How we hire

Our hiring process is designed to really get to know you - how you think, what you’ve built, and what drives you. It’s also your opportunity to get to know us, too.

We make hiring decisions based on your skills, experience and passion, as well as what you’d bring to our culture. So even if you think you don’t quite match what’s listed above, and you’re excellent at what you do, we’d still love to hear from you.

When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

Please note that all interviews are conducted virtually.

What you’d be doing in this role

You will be a dedicated, in-region customer support team member. Enterprise Admin Support Specialists are case managers who strongly focus on owning and resolving support tickets for our most strategic customers.

As part of a regional team, our specialists will be co-located and seamlessly integrated with the Sales and Success teams. This will facilitate better coordination and faster resolution of customer concerns. The selected individuals will possess expert knowledge in all Enterprise account and brand administration tasks and will be highly trained in supporting the Sales and Success teams with back-office tasks as needed.

At the moment, this role is focused on:

  • Manage and prioritise Enterprise support tickets across account administration, feature functionality, and platform configuration, ensuring timely resolution in line with service standards.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve standard support issues by analysing root causes and applying established workflows, escalating when needed.
  • Support Admins through scheduled calls to guide issue resolution, key workflows, and best practices, with clear and timely follow-up.
  • Partner with Sales and CSM teams to provide technical and back-office support during onboarding and escalations, ensuring alignment on customer needs.
  • Apply working knowledge of Canva enterprise features (e.g. SSO/SCIM, Brand Kit, User Management) to resolve cases, and contribute to team knowledge through documentation updates and sharing ticket trends.
  • In addition to the core responsibilities, this role will also contribute to our Strategic Pod Support program. This initiative is designed to enhance customer retention, product adoption, and revenue expansion through targeted, high-impact support aligned with Customer Success goals.

You're probably a match if

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte, こんにちは!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where and how you can work

Our headquarters is in sunny Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role we’re focusing on Tokyo, Japan. So we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.

This role requires at least 20 hours of work per week. このポジションは、週に最低20時間の稼働を想定しています。

What you’ll do (responsibilities)

担当いただく業務

This role is focused on our template Library — the design content marketplace where millions of users start their design journey — rather than Brand or external-facing creative work. 本ポジションは、何百万人ものユーザーがデザインの第一歩を踏み出す場である、テンプレートライブラリ（デザインコンテンツのマーケットプレイス）に特化した役割であり、ブランドや対外向けクリエイティブ制作は対象外です。

  • Create a range of fresh, varied and beautiful designs for our Japan community. 日本のコミュニティ向けに、新鮮でバラエティ豊かな美しいデザインを幅広く制作します。

  • Develop unique concepts for templates across themes and topics that resonate in Japan. 日本のユーザーの共感を呼ぶテーマやトピックに沿って、テンプレートのユニークなコンセプトを開発します。

  • Collaborate with asset creators to develop supporting design elements — illustrations and design elements — that make templates shine. アセットクリエイターと連携し、テンプレートを引き立てるイラストや写真素材などのアセット開発をサポートします。

  • Suggest new design styles and creative directions that fit what local users want. ローカルユーザーのニーズに合った新しいデザインスタイルやクリエイティブの方向性を提案します。

  • Focus on quality management for Creator templates, partnering with the Creator Template Review Team to lift overall design quality and keep everything on-brand. クリエイターテンプレートの品質管理に注力し、クリエイターテンプレートレビューチームと連携して全体的なデザイン品質を高め、ブランドとの整合性を維持します。

  • Use AI tools to create templates at scale for the Japan market, without compromising craft or cultural relevance. AIツールを活用し、クオリティや文化的な関連性を損なうことなく、日本市場向けにテンプレートを大規模に制作します。

  • Write Creator briefs that give clear direction, context and inspiration, so Creators can do their best work. クリエイターが最高の成果を発揮できるよう、明確な方向性・背景情報・インスピレーションを伝えるクリエイターブリーフを作成します。

  • Partner with the Design Lead to manage freelancer designers — keeping work on track, on-brief and shipping on deadline. デザインリードと連携し、フリーランスデザイナーをマネジメントします。進行管理、ブリーフとの整合性、納期内の納品を徹底します。

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
What we're looking for

求める人物像・スキル

  • Experience as a Graphic, Brand or Visual Designer across digital and print marketing. デジタルおよび印刷媒体のマーケティング領域における、グラフィックデザイナー、ブランドデザイナー、またはビジュアルデザイナーとしての実務経験をお持ちの方。

  • A genuine love for design trends and styles specific to Japan. 日本ならではのデザイントレンドやスタイルに強い関心と情熱をお持ちの方。

  • A portfolio that shows your passion for clean, elegant, beautiful design. 洗練された、シンプルで美しいデザインへのこだわりが伝わるポートフォリオをお持ちの方。

  • Strong craft in hand illustration, typography, colour, conceptual graphic design and layout. 手描きイラスト、タイポグラフィ、カラー、コンセプチュアルなグラフィックデザイン、レイアウトにおいて、高いデザインスキルをお持ちの方。

  • A sharp eye for visual, cultural and pop culture trends. ビジュアル、カルチャー、ポップカルチャーのトレンドを敏感に捉える感性をお持ちの方。

  • A strong stylistic point of view, grounded in design fundamentals. デザインの基礎をしっかりと身につけたうえで、自分なりの明確なスタイルやクリエイティブの視点をお持ちの方。

  • You design with the end user in mind, and deliver great work on deadline and to brief. 常にエンドユーザーを意識してデザインし、ブリーフに沿った高品質な成果物を期限内に仕上げられる方。

  • You've given design feedback before — and you know how to make it clear, kind and useful. デザインに対するフィードバックの経験があり、明確かつ相手を尊重した、実践につながるフィードバックができる方。

  • You're comfortable using AI tools in your design workflow, and curious about pushing them further. デザインワークフローの中でAIツールを活用することに抵抗がなく、その可能性をさらに広げていくことに意欲的な方。

  • You can write a tight creative brief that sets other designers up for success. 他のデザイナーが成果を出しやすいよう、要点を押さえた明確なクリエイティブブリーフを作成できる方。

  • Experience using Canva is a plus, helping you get up to speed quickly from day one. Canvaの使用経験があると、入社初日からスムーズに業務を進められるため歓迎します。

When applying to this role, please provide the following:

ご応募の際は、以下をご提出ください

  • Your resume 履歴書・職務経歴書

  • A link to your portfolio ポートフォリオへのリンク

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
About the Group/Team

Our marketplace of templates provides the perfect place for our users to begin their design journey. The Canva team wants to work with talented designers from across the world, to redefine what’s possible for a template - creating a new benchmark for fresh, high-quality design content within our collection. We're aiming to build the world’s best design marketplace, with a library of designs that offer our users a wide variety of usable and dynamic content - and to do that, we need the help of talented designers that can create amazing content.

About the Role/Specialty

Canva's on a mission to democratise design, and localisation is a big part of that. It's not enough to translate content from English — we want every market to have templates that reflect their own design aesthetics and trends. Working closely with copywriters, illustrators, market growth and localisation specialists, you'll oversee the end-to-end rollout of the Japan content library.

This role goes beyond designing templates yourself. You'll also shape what our external Creators make — writing clear Creator briefs, managing quality of their template submissions, and using AI to create templates at scale for the Japan market. You'll partner with the Design Lead to help manage our freelancer designers, keeping work aligned, on-brief and on-time.
