companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
About the Group/Team

We're Canva's Japan team, part of our International Supergroup. Our job is to make Canva feel truly local for people across Japan, working across marketing, partnerships and localisation. We're based in Shibuya, in the heart of Tokyo's creative scene, and we work closely with teams around the world, including our global HQ in Sydney. We're growing quickly, and there's real appetite to invest in the market and do the best work of our lives here.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
About the Role/Specialty

As Growth Marketing Lead, you'll own Canva Japan's growth marketing end-to-end, from awareness and acquisition through to activation, conversion, retention and revenue, building data-driven strategies across the full customer journey. You'll directly manage our digital advertising channels in-house rather than through an agency, so you're close to the data and in control of every lever. You'll pair deep, practical advertising expertise with an experimental mindset and a genuine understanding of Japanese consumers, and you'll work with local and global marketing, creative, product, data and localisation teams to find and scale what works. 

Goals you’ll achieve

0-6 month goals

  • Take full, hands-on ownership of Japan's digital advertising channels, running day-to-day setup, optimisation and budget management directly in-platform.

  • Build a clear view of the Japan funnel from acquisition to revenue, and identify the highest-impact growth opportunities from customer behaviour, market trends and campaign data.

  • Stand up a structured testing roadmap across channels, audiences and creative concepts, with clear goals and measurement in place.

6-12 month goals

  • Improve core efficiency metrics (CAC, CPA, ROAS and conversion rate) and show measurable incremental lift from paid investment.

  • Scale the channels and campaigns that work, reallocating budget based on performance, incrementality and business impact.

  • Partner with local creative to ship truly local ad concepts that lift conversion with Japanese audiences, and establish a clear read on which messages and formats drive results.

What you’ll do (responsibilities)

  • Develop and execute Canva Japan's growth marketing strategy across acquisition, activation, conversion, retention and revenue growth.

  • Manage the marketing budget and allocate investment based on performance, incrementality and business impact.

  • Directly manage all digital advertising in-house across Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok, X, Apple Search Ads and other relevant platforms, owning campaign setup, daily optimisation, performance analysis and budget management.

  • Run campaigns across brand, consideration, app acquisition, website conversion, subscription and revenue objectives, defining audience, bidding, placement, attribution and measurement strategies.

  • Track, analyse and report on performance against metrics like CAC, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, video completion rate, revenue and incremental lift, and turn that data into clear budget and investment decisions.

  • Build and run a structured testing roadmap across channels, audiences, creative concepts, landing pages and campaign objectives.

  • Partner with the local creative team to develop and evaluate advertising concepts built specifically for Japanese audiences.

  • Collaborate with local and global marketing, creative, product, data and localisation teams to identify and scale growth opportunities.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
What we're looking for

  • Around 7 or more years in growth, performance or digital marketing, with hands-on experience managing significant advertising budgets directly in-platform (across search, app, web, social and video) rather than overseeing an agency.

  • Strong knowledge of attribution, analytics, experimentation, conversion optimisation and incrementality measurement.

  • Strong analytical and business judgment, using performance data to make confident budget and investment calls that grow users and revenue.

  • Proven ability to run campaigns end-to-end and independently, from developing the strategy and setting up campaigns to managing bids and budgets, analysing performance and implementing optimisations.

  • A deep understanding of Japanese consumers, their media behaviour and the local digital platform landscape, and the ability to translate that into campaigns that resonate.

  • A curious, proactive self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, takes measured risks and communicates effectively with both local and global stakeholders.

  • Native-level Japanese and business-level English (both essential for this role).

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
What you will learn and how will you develop at Canva

  • Build Canva Japan's in-house growth marketing engine from a position of genuine ownership, shaping how we invest and grow in one of our priority markets.

  • Sharpen your craft in incrementality, experimentation and measurement, backed by meaningful budgets and strong global data and creative support.

  • Grow into a market-level growth leader, working across local and global teams and helping set the standard for how Canva grows in Japan.

jobs.name: Senior Graphic AI Designer (6 Month Contract)

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where and how you can work

Alongside our global campuses, we also collaborate with talented contractors and freelancers from all over the world to help us achieve our crazy big goals. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role we’re focusing on Sydney/Melbourne so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.

This is a 6-month engagement working full time hours. 

What you'd be doing
As Canva scales, change continues to be part of our DNA — and nowhere is that more exciting than in AI. We’re building world-leading visual AI, and this role plays a critical part in making that happen.

You’ll sit at the intersection of design, data, and AI research, bringing world-class visual judgment into the model training and evaluation loop. In a Core Research environment, your work will materially strengthen the feedback systems that push our models toward premium, intuitive, and globally competitive performance.

At the moment, this role is focused on:

• Annotating and labeling large volumes of visual data — including images, UI layouts, compositions, graphics, and photography — with high precision
• Evaluating AI-generated outputs for aesthetic quality, composition, accessibility, usability, and brand alignment
• Developing visual scoring rubrics and structured evaluation frameworks to guide model improvement
• Identifying patterns, failure modes, and edge cases to help improve model performance
• Translating nuanced design critique into structured, actionable feedback for ML engineers and research scientists
• Using generative AI tools to prototype workflows, test hypotheses, and creatively explore model behaviors
• Contributing to the development of taxonomies for visual styles, attributes, and design patterns
• Maintaining high standards of data quality and documentation across annotation projects

You're probably a match if

• You have strong design fundamentals — composition, color theory, typography, layout, hierarchy, and storytelling are second nature to you
• You have a portfolio that demonstrates visual excellence across graphic design, product design, UI/UX, illustration, or related domains
• You’re familiar with generative AI tools and understand how training data and annotation influence model behavior
• You can evaluate visual outputs with precision and clearly articulate structured, repeatable feedback
• You’re comfortable working in documentation-heavy, cross-functional environments
• You’re excited by the idea of shaping how AI models “see” and “create”

Bonus points if you have:

• Experience with Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, or 3D tools
• Prior annotation, data labeling, or ML operations experience
• Basic familiarity with Python, prompt engineering, or dataset tooling
• Knowledge of accessibility guidelines (e.g. WCAG), usability heuristics, or user research 

About the team
This role sits within Content Studio in the Content & Discovery Supergroup — the team focused on empowering the world through world-class content.

We combine creativity, research, and technology to ensure Canva delivers visually outstanding, accessible, and globally relevant design experiences. As Canva accelerates its AI capabilities, Content Studio plays a key role in embedding design excellence directly into model development.

You’ll collaborate with researchers, ML engineers, product managers, and designers to ensure Canva’s visual AI feels premium, human-centered, and unmistakably Canva.

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

Portfolio Assessment

To be considered, please include a portfolio that showcases your strong graphic design craft and hands-on visual AI work — from AI-generated imagery and prompt experimentation to creating content at scale, assessing quality and improving outputs through annotation, evaluation or model-training workflows.

Other stuff to know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

  • Mentor and support the growth of teammates through knowledge sharing, operational guidance, and investigation best practices

You're probably a match if

  • You have experience leading or coordinating security investigations, digital forensics, or incident response activities in complex environments

  • You’re comfortable working cross-functionally with Legal, People, and Security teams, and can communicate clearly during high-pressure situations

  • You’re able to translate complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, including non-technical stakeholders

  • You’ve built or improved detection, automation, case management, or response workflows at scale

  • You have hands-on experience investigating macOS environments, alongside Linux and Windows systems

  • You’re comfortable designing, building, and improving security tooling and operational workflows

  • You’re confident working with SIEM, EDR, endpoint telemetry, and security investigation tooling

  • You enjoy solving ambiguous problems and proactively improving systems, processes, and operational maturity

  • You bring empathy, sound judgement, humility, and a collaborative mindset to sensitive investigations and incident coordination

  • You have programming or scripting experience in languages such as Python, Golang, or Java

Nice to have experience

  • Experience with insider threat programs or user behaviour analytics (UBA/UEBA)

  • Familiarity with DLP technologies and endpoint monitoring solutions

  • Experience building security automation or orchestration tooling

  • Exposure to legal evidence handling, privacy investigations, or law enforcement collaboration

  • Experience operating in cloud-native or large-scale SaaS environments


About the team

The Security Group is responsible for protecting Canva systems and data from information security threats. Our teams work together — and with other groups across Canva — to deliver preventive and detective controls that reduce security risk at scale.

The Security Operations team supports internal groups including Legal, People, and Security. We work to protect Canva’s intellectual property, customer data, and strategic information through proactive detection, investigation, and mitigation of threats, while maintaining a culture of trust and transparency.

Canva’s goal is to become the world’s most trusted platform, which makes security a top priority. This team plays a critical role in safeguarding Canva’s systems, data, and the information our users entrust to us every day.

What's in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

Here's a taste of what's on offer:

  • Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too

  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers

  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more

  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

Other stuff to know

We see AI as a powerful amplifier of creativity and technology at Canva. We’re evolving how we assess AI skills in our Technology hiring experience - you’ll tackle interactive, real-time challenges that reflect the kind of work we do. In some interviews, you may also be asked to solve a problem using an AI tool to show how you approach challenges with tech by your side. Your recruitment partner will walk you through what to expect.

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above - we still want to hear from you!

companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
About the Group/Team

CJKI is the group responsible for making Canva feel like a local product in four of its most dynamic markets - China, Japan, Korea, and India. We sit within Canva's International Supergroup, whose mission is to empower those closest to our international customers to drive Truly Local growth across our top 40 markets.

Our group operates with genuine autonomy, building in-market functions across marketing, product, engineering, data, and user voice - with the support of Canva's central teams behind us.

India is one of our most active and ambitious subgroups, with growing teams in SEO, marketing, and product all working toward the same goal: making Canva indispensable for Indian creators, educators, and businesses, and growing our active user base in the country.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
About the Role/Specialty

This is a opportunity to help build Canva's marketing presence for Indian users across touchpoints. You'll plan & create content that shows up where Indian users actually are: on Canva's homepage, in the product itself, on their social feeds, and on YouTube where hundreds of millions of Indians search for how-tos, tools, and inspiration every day.

You'll work closely with the India Marketing team, with clear direction and room to develop your craft. This isn't a single-channel role - you'll stretch across planning content, writing scripts, writing product interface copy, producing content, coordinating with agencies to make production-heavy content, and CMS management. You will get a real view of what full-funnel content marketing looks like in one of the world's most exciting digital markets.

 

What you’ll do (responsibilities)

  • Plan content across touchpoints - from a social ad to a YouTube tutorial to a product surface - so every piece of content is shaped for the context in which it lands.

  • Script & produce a bank of short-form video content for multiple touchpoints - so the Marketing team always has fresh, tested content to work with.

  • Brief and coordinate with external agencies or internal creative teams to make production-heavy content, specially video content.

  • Experiment with new content formats for Canva's product surfaces - including the homepage, landing pages and other surfaces, such as highlights, videos, learning cards, etc.

  • Manage end-to-end content execution - content scheduling, CMS uploads, A/B tests across platforms and surfaces.

  • Coordinate localisation across languages where needed - a working understanding of Hindi is required, as most India localisation will be in this language.

  • Measure the impact of the content, and calibrate future plans according to new insights and learnings.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
What we're looking for

  • You write clearly and versatilely across formats - from punchy Shorts scripts to instructional video copy to product interface language.

  • You're an avid Canva user who knows the product's workflows and use cases inside out - you can speak credibly about what Canva can do, and that knowledge shows up naturally in the content you create.

  • You think in channels and touchpoints - you instinctively ask "where will someone see this, and what do they need from it at that moment?" before you write or brief a single word.

  • You are comfortable facing the camera, and have a good screen presence to represent a brand like Canva in India.

  • You have a sharp eye for social and design trends - you're the kind of person who spots an emerging content format or visual style early, and can translate that into new ideas.

  • You take genuine ownership of your output - you flag blockers early, manage your own time across multiple content surfaces, and care about whether your work actually lands with users.

  • You're comfortable working to a brief and taking feedback in your stride - you see revision as part of the craft, not a setback.

  • You have a good understanding of Hindi and are comfortable reviewing or briefing localised content to ensure it reads naturally for Indian users - not just translated, but truly local.

  • You're based in Bangalore and ready to contribute across a range of content types from day one.

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
What you will learn and how you will develop at Canva

  • Multi-surface content marketing - you'll develop real experience writing & producing social content, product content, and YouTube in a single role, giving you a rounded view of how content works across the funnel.

  • Stakeholder and project management - you'll learn how to brief external agencies, manage feedback loops, and keep multiple content workstreams moving at once, building production and stakeholder coordination skills that are invaluable in any marketing role.

  • YouTube & social content strategy - you'll learn how to build a content funnel designed around search behaviour, create for discoverability, and grow an audience in one of the world's most competitive YouTube markets.

  • A strong, full-funnel content portfolio - over 12 months, you'll have published work across social media, product interfaces, homepage, and other touchpoints.

jobs.name: Staff Finance Systems Engineer - Order to Cash (San Francisco and Bay Area only)

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Hello, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where and how you can work

Our flagship office is in Sydney, Australia, but we've made our way from down under, to a hub in San Francisco, which is now home to our US operations. We offer flexibility in how and where you work. We trust our Canvanauts to choose the balance that empowers them and their team to achieve their goals.

What you’d be doing in this role

As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.

Revenue is the single figure most scrutinised by the market, auditors and Canva's own leadership as we move toward public-company operations. A Staff-level owner of this domain closes the current gap between the complexity of the Rev Recognition and O2C decision space and the seniority needed to own it credibly — reducing SOX risk, giving Finance a single accountable technical voice across Sales Systems, Revenue Platforms, and Finance Data, and ensuring the architecture we land on is one this person can defend under real scrutiny rather than one assembled by committee.

At the moment, this role is focused on:

  • Developing a strong understanding of Canva's end-to-end B2B & B2C Order to Cash process and the systems that support it - including NetSuite (B2B billing), Zuora (revenue recognition), payment gateways, collections management and downstream reporting - and triaging all major changes to these systems or their integrations

  • Own system and process improvement projects across stakeholders including Revenue Platform Engineering, Finance Data Platform, Business Data Platform and Finance Revenue Operations, as well as external vendors

  • Stay current with changes across the O2C system landscape and support the Finance team in assessing impacts on financial reporting and underlying business logic

  • Maintain/build working knowledge of adjacent systems - including sales compensation, and general ledger integrations - to support cross-system change assessment and ensure data integrity across the Finance platform

  • Assist the Finance team in implementing system monitoring controls (SOX & ITGC) and audits to ensure data accuracy, compliance, and adherence to established policies and procedures

  • Perform troubleshooting and technical root cause analysis in collaboration with stakeholders to deliver permanent solutions

  • Continuously assess system performance and identify opportunities for improvement, implementing optimisation strategies to enhance efficiency and user experience

  • Collate and maintain all relevant documentation throughout the process as required by advisors, auditors and management



You're probably a match if you have

We are looking for a talented, outcome-driven individual who has:

  • 10+ years in finance systems engineering, with deep hands-on experience in Order to Cash and revenue recognition; public company / SOX environment experience is highly desirable

  • Demonstrated ownership of a multi-system architecture decision not just implementation of a defined solution, ideally spanning ERP, billing, and revenue recognition platforms

  • A track record of being given a vague, high-stakes mandate and independently shaping it into a scoped, resourced technical roadmap that senior stakeholders acted on

  • Comfort operating as the technical authority in a room of Finance and Engineering stakeholders where the recommendation itself, not just the implementation, is being challenged

  • Working knowledge across adjacent systems (Sales Systems, Revenue Platforms, Finance Data, sales compensation, general ledger) sufficient to reason about cross-system impact without needing to be the domain expert in each

  • Strong grounding in ASC 606/IFRS 15 and the ability to translate O2C and revenue recognition requirements into system architecture, not just configuration

  • Proficiency in SQL and data tooling to investigate cross-system discrepancies at the architecture level

  • Evidence of authoring standards or frameworks that other engineers or teams have adopted beyond your own immediate team

We’d also love if you had:

  • Ability to operate and be successful in high growth B2B and B2C environments, and thrive on problem solving and dealing with ambiguity, willing to get your hands dirty when needed. Be comfortable with chaos.

  • A track record of mentoring senior (B2/B3) engineers without formal reporting lines

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Comfort holding a technical position under scrutiny from Finance leadership, and revising it credibly when the evidence warrants

  • Proactive, independent to get work done and collaborative to bring people on the journey. We are a team of team players!

About the team

The Information Technology (IT) Group’s vision is to maximise the potential of every Canvanaut through world class technology & service. We realise our vision through our mission pillars to evolve business operations, accelerate productivity and future proof our foundations which serve as the basis for the IT strategies we execute upon.

As part of the IT - Business Platforms Group, the Finance Systems team supports the evaluation, implementation, administration, and ongoing innovation of the technology stack across the Finance & Accounting domains. Our team is solving some of Canva’s biggest challenges by automating and improving the quality of our processes to allow our employees to do their best work at a place they love. We strive to be integrated with the Finance strategy so we can realise our vision of being the best company in the world.

About the role
This is a domain systems engineering role for someone who designs and builds cross-functional capability, rather than owning a single system in isolation. You'll be given a goal with a large number of technical unknowns — e.g. "define Canva's target-state revenue recognition architecture" — and be expected to:

  • Assess every system that touches or is impacted by that goal (NetSuite, Zuora, Snowflake, Sales Systems, Revenue Platforms, Finance Data) to establish complexity and business priority

  • Develop the technical proposal where no existing playbook applies

  • Bring a resourcing and sequencing recommendation to group leadership, not just a technical design

  • Be the go-to person other engineering teams route through when their work touches revenue recognition or O2C

You'll partner deeply with Finance leadership, Revenue Platform Engineering, Finance Data Platform, Sales Systems, and Business Data Platform and represent Canva's technical position to vendors (Zuora/Netsuite/Workato) at a strategic level, not just an operational one.

 

What's in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

Here's a taste of what's on offer:

  • Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too

  • Health benefits plans to support you and your wellbeing

  • 401(k) retirement plan with company contribution

  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers

  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more

  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

At Canva we value fairness, and we strive to provide competitive, market-informed compensation whilst ensuring internal equity within the team in each region. We make hiring decisions based on your skills, experience and our overall assessment of what we observed and learnt in the hiring process. The target salary range for this position is $205,000 to $316,000. When calculating offers, we make salary decisions based on market data and candidates' skills and experience.

Other stuff to know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills, merit and business needs, in compliance with applicable local laws.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above - we still want to hear from you!

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Our flagship campus is in Sydney. We also have a campus in Austin, Texas and San Francisco, California. But you have choice in where and how you work. That means if you want to do your thing in the office (if you're near one), at home or a bit of both, it's up to you.

About the Group

We are building a team of A-player sellers focused on creating value for our customers. The value we create with Canva Enterprise in the content and design lifecycle is massive. Our cross-functional team is global and well rounded, and supports a business that is multi-faceted. With over 260M monthly active users who love to use Canva, we are lucky to have a nearly unlimited pipeline of opportunities. Our sellers have a clear career path, from BDR to SMB all the way up to Strategic sales. And we’re supported by a talented team of product marketers and enablement professionals who partner with us to ensure we’re equipped to win. In short, this team is built for and ready to scale.


About the Role

SMB and Mid Market are Canva's highest-PMF segments. There are thousands of US businesses still stuck on inferior products, and we've just started building the tools to serve them at scale. We’re building Canva Grow, which is custom built for SMB and Mid Market companies. The market is waiting.

You'll be the person who builds the team and motion to capture it.

What you’d be doing in this role

As Canva scales, change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavor of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.

At the moment, this role is focused on:

  • Revenue growth: rapidly grow Canva Enterprise in the North America region, amongst a team of MidMarket and SMB AEs, to help hit the company’s overall Enterprise revenue targets

  • Customer enthusiasm: extend Canva’s tradition of high customer satisfaction across teams and continue to prioritize user feedback and excitement as the Canva Enterprise business accelerates

  • Best-in-class processes, practices, and efficiency: create, educate and refine the team practices, sales playbooks, and KPIs needed for operating as a top SaaS business (including but not limited to): pipeline development, conversion rates, forecasting, hiring, performance management, enablement, training, partnerships, and cross-functional collaboration

  • Hire, motivate, develop and retain top talent: build a team of A-players and raise the talent bar for the organization

  • Build great partnerships: come together with an exceptional sales development and operations team alongside the product and marketing dream team ensuring we are offering an exceptional experience for Enterprise customers!

  • Tools we use: Gong, Salesforce, Ironclad, etc

  • Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

 

Goals you’ll achieve

Grow the business

  • Own the number across Mid Market and SMB in the US

  • Spot where we're winning, where we're not, and move fast on both

  • Partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Partnerships to unlock new opportunities

Build an amazing team

  • Recruit and develop the best sales talent in the market

  • Build world-class training and enablement programs

  • Create a culture where the best people want to stay and grow

  • Promote from within, your team feeds talent up the entire sales org

Drive the strategy

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
About the Group/Team

The International SEO team sits within Canva’s Growth SuperGroup and plays a critical role in helping users across the globe discover Canva through search. We work across markets, languages, and content surfaces—from templates to landing pages—driving both top-of-funnel growth and long-term user value.

Our team thrives on combining craft excellence with systems thinking, making SEO a force multiplier for international impact.

About the role

As Canva scales, change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavor of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.

Canva's SEO is world-class, and we're looking for a passionate SEO Content Specialist to join the International SEO team to help scale our next phase of growth in Japan! This is a 12-month contract role, starting at 20 hours per week, with the option to scale up to 40 hours per week.

The SEO Content Specialist will work closely with the Japan SEO Lead and local team. The role of an SEO Content Specialist is to create and manage engaging, SEO-optimized copy and content that informs, inspires, and converts local audiences.

As an SEO Content Specialist, you will provide initiative, direction, and support to create helpful and culturally relevant content for users in the Japan market. You are a native Japanese speaker with proficient reading and writing skills in English, and having conversational English abilities is a nice to have.

Canva is a fast-growing, mission-driven company, and we're looking for talented people who want to contribute to something meaningful. If you're excited about the opportunity to make an impact, show us what you've got—strong performers in this role have significant opportunities to grow with us.

About the team

The International SEO team is responsible for improving SEO performance of logged-out pages across the Canva website. Our mission in SEO is to empower every user in the world to discover Canva.

We're a global team of specialists spanning keyword research, technical SEO, content strategy, outreach, engineering, data analytics, design, and operations. We work across many regions and languages, combining proven frameworks with deep local market expertise. 

What you’ll do (responsibilities)

Content Creation & Optimization

  • Champion content requirements for landing pages and blog articles, supporting the development of long-term content strategy by maintaining an up-to-date editorial calendar and publishing plan
  • Create and edit SEO-optimized, engaging content about various design topics that align with the SEO team's content strategy and resonate with local audiences
  • Upload and publish content that follows the latest SEO best practices and fits our local tone of voice (as defined by our language managers)
  • Regularly track and optimize landing pages to maintain freshness, improve content credibility, and enhance user engagement
  • Maintain a high level of quality and consistency in alignment with Canva's brand guidelines
  • Provide feedback on content management systems, translation quality, and page layout to continuously improve efficiency and quality

Collaboration & Strategic Partnership

  • Work closely with the wider Japan SEO team to align on goals, priorities, and SEO best practices that drive growth
  • Support broader SEO activities such as keyword research, competitor analysis, and collaboration with Outreach Specialists for content production
  • Collaborate with the country SEO team and broader marketing/community teams to ensure content strategy reflects local market dynamics and user needs
  • Contribute local market intelligence and user insights that inform content priorities and opportunity identification
  • Build relationships across functions to understand how your content work supports broader country initiatives

Navigating the Evolution of Search & Discovery

  • Stay curious about emerging search and discovery trends in your market—including how users find information through AI-powered platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google's AI Overviews, etc.)
  • Understand where traditional SEO drives value versus where new channels and approaches may be more effective in your country
  • Stay up to date on GEO/AEO evolutions and next-generation optimization techniques
  • Be open to experimenting with new content formats and optimization approaches as the search landscape evolves
  • Share observations and learnings about how users in your market discover content, contributing to our global understanding of emerging trends

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
What we're looking for

Core Skills & Experience

  • Native or near-native proficiency in Japanese with business-level English
  • Proven experience in SEO content writing and/or content marketing, with a portfolio demonstrating successful outcomes (minimum of 3 years of SEO experience required)
  • Strong copywriting and copy editing skills, including experience giving constructive feedback to other writers
  • Experience with editorial planning and publishing content in a CMS (content management system)
  • Solid understanding of SEO fundamentals: keyword optimization, content structure, user intent, and how content fits within broader SEO strategy
  • Familiarity with SEO tools like Ahrefs, Semrush, or similar platforms (bonus!)
  • Experience using web analytics tools to understand how users engage with content and to measure content performance
  • High attention to detail with the ability to closely follow detailed written instructions and maintain quality standards
  • Strong time management: Ability to self-manage capacity, meet project deadlines, and balance multiple priorities
  • Experience in creating landing page assets

Cultural & Market Intelligence

  • Deep understanding of local cultural and linguistic nuances that goes beyond language fluency—you know what resonates with audiences in your market
  • Appreciation of local writing trends and content preferences, ensuring content feels native rather than translated
  • Ability to identify opportunities specific to your market that may not be obvious from a global perspective

Collaboration & Communication

  • Excellent communication skills: Clear, proactive, and transparent in both written and verbal communication
  • Collaborative mindset: You build relationships easily, work well across teams, and contribute positively to team culture 
  • Willingness to give and receive feedback constructively, always aiming to improve quality and impact  

Future-Oriented & Adaptable Mindset

  • Curiosity about emerging channels: You're actively interested in how discovery is evolving—including AI search, LLMs, social search, and new platforms—and you're eager to learn
  • Comfort with ambiguity: You can experiment with new approaches (like content formatting for AI-generated answers) even when best practices are still being established
  • Channel-agnostic thinking: You understand that "SEO" increasingly means "discoverability"—whether through traditional search engines, AI tools, social platforms, or channels yet to emerge
  • Data-driven adaptability: You can objectively assess what's working and adjust your approach based on performance and market signals
  • Early adopter energy: You're the type of person who's already exploring how Canva appears in new discovery channels, bringing insights and ideas rather than waiting for direction

Bonuses

  • Familiarity with YouTube SEO and video content discoverability, given YouTube's strong presence in the Japanese search landscape
  • Prior experience in SEO strategy development and planning is a plus

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
The A-Player Standard

We're setting a high bar—because International is becoming Canva's biggest growth driver, and we need exceptional people driving it.

What "A-Player" means in this role:

  • Strategic thinker: You define what should be done and why (not just execute)
  • Relationship builder: You make collaboration easy and productive
  • Problem solver: You're resourceful and resilient when challenges arise
  • Data-driven: You use insights to drive decisions and demonstrate impact
  • Ownership mindset: You act like it's your business, not just your job
  • Growth-oriented: You're constantly learning, adapting, and improving

This role is based at our Prague office which is set in a thoughtfully renovated space in the historic heart of the city on iconic Na Příkopě street. It’s a unique blend of three buildings brought together to create a one-of-a-kind layout. While our global HQ is in Sydney, Australia, Prague offers its own distinct charm, with a cosy, creative space that blends modern design with old-world character and is thoughtfully designed for collaboration, focus and connection.

About the team

Meet Vibe. We're the team behind the buzz, the good food, the great events, and the spaces people actually want to come into. We're part of the People SuperGroup, and our whole mission comes down to one thing: making Canva a place where people love to be, and can do the best work of their lives.

That means we wear a lot of hats. Planning the Campuses and experiences of the future. Keeping the ones we've got running like clockwork. Throwing events people actually talk about afterwards. Making sure there's always something yummy on the table. We're the ones who show up early, stay late, and genuinely love making other people's days better.

As Canva's grown, so have we. Vibe spans Workplace Experience, Facilities and Construction, Food and Beverage, Health and Wellbeing, and Events and Engagement, and we're only getting more ambitious from here.

If you love people, thrive on energy, and get a kick out of pulling off something great for a room full of people, you'll fit right in.

About the role

This is a fixed-term maternity leave cover for our Prague Campus. You will be required to be on-site 4 days per week. You'll step into the role of ambassador for Canva's values and mission at a pivotal time, keeping our culture and workplace experience running without a beat missed.

You'll lead Vibe initiatives across Real Estate, Facilities and Construction, Office Operations, Hospitality, Workplace Experience, Events, and Sustainability at the Prague Campus, based on-site. You'll bring ongoing Vibe projects together, keep communication flowing between stakeholders and project owners, and work closely with teams across the business to keep projects, events, and administrative work moving. Your focus is Prague, but you'll also support other European Vibe team members when needed and collaborate with colleagues globally.

What you’ll do

Drawing on your expertise in program and facilities management, workplace experience, communications, and relationship building, you'll collaborate cross-functionally to provide foundational support for our team with a global mindset. Given the temporary nature of this role as parental leave coverage, your contributions will be crucial in maintaining continuity and momentum within the Prague Campus during the contract period.

Office Vibe & Events

  • Create, manage, and facilitate inspiring events and social activations at our Campus

  • Work with our Global Vibe Team to curate fun, engaging hybrid and remote-friendly events

  • Manage bump in and bump out for all events

  • Keep our local team engaged and informed through effective Vibe communications

  • Own the Prague budget for Vibe programs, events, facilities, and maintenance

  • Act as the main point of contact between the central team and local stakeholders, including contractors, suppliers, and local authorities

Engagement, Culture & Office Facilities

  • Build on existing cultural programs and policies that make the biggest impact on employees and guests through hospitality, events, and engagement

  • Rally teams to celebrate their milestones, big or small

  • Build relationships with stakeholders to understand their business needs and use that insight to improve the employee experience

  • Regularly assess workplace readiness and operations, keeping Canva standards high while reflecting local culture

  • Support our global Facilities team in running processes in line with global policy

What we're looking for

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills

  • Comfortable setting priorities, planning and organising, and pivoting quickly when things change

  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through on incoming tasks

  • A problem solver who looks at processes from outside the box and is always looking to innovate and streamline as we scale

  • A hospitality and customer service mindset, with a genuine desire to host, build relationships, and create great experiences for your guests

  • A strategic thinker who can plan ahead while staying practical about what needs to happen right now

  • Comfortable managing senior stakeholders and advocating for the Vibe team's expertise

  • A collaborative approach, this role touches many teams across the office and needs strong communication and teamwork

  • A natural sense of prioritisation, you can see what needs doing and judge what matters most in the moment

Why this role:

You'll get real ownership of a Campus, direct exposure to senior stakeholders, and the chance to shape how a few hundred people experience Canva every day, all while building skills across facilities, events, hospitality, and stakeholder management that carry well beyond a single role. Above all, you’ll have lots fun along the way.

We're building an inclusive culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work.

You’ll serve as a technical authority across Canva, setting strategic direction for AI security and defining the frameworks, standards, and secure-by-design patterns that enable safe AI adoption across both our product and broader business landscape. You’ll be working closely with engineering, product, AI research, and business stakeholders in a high-impact role where you’ll shape how Canva secures AI both now and for the future.

At the moment, this role is focused on:

  • Define the strategic direction and security frameworks for AI systems at scale, and lead the design and implementation of controls across model training pipelines, inference endpoints, and AI-powered features across Canva's platform

  • Lead novel research into emerging AI security threats and attack vectors, and drive threat modelling, vulnerability assessments, and penetration testing focused on risks such as prompt injection, model poisoning, and data extraction

  • Serve as the technical authority for AI security across Canva by leading security reviews and code assessments for AI use cases, identifying risks and providing actionable recommendations to mitigate potential threats

  • Drive the strategy and development of detection rules and response playbooks tailored to AI-specific security incidents and anomalous behaviour, ensuring they scale across Canva’s AI footprint

  • Lead organisation-wide AI security standards and best practices by collaborating with stakeholders across the business (including executive leadership) to embed secure-by-design workflows, and mentor and guide other security engineers working on AI initiatives

You're probably a match if

  • You bring deep technical expertise in AI security, with a track record of novel research and innovation -  and the ability to apply that knowledge pragmatically to real-world challenges at scale.

  • You have a proven ability to explore genuinely unknown security problems, think holistically across product and business contexts, and set strategic direction in a fast-moving, ambiguous space.

  • You're a recognised technical authority and thought leader who can influence senior stakeholders, align cross-functional teams, and drive outcomes without a clear playbook.

  • You balance risk, usability, and velocity intuitively - enabling safe AI adoption at scale without slowing down the teams building it.

  • You're self-motivated and thrive in high-paced environments, bringing calm, high-leverage leadership when the path forward isn't obvious.

  • You're a strong communicator and fast networker in large organisations, with the ability to build trust quickly across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders.

  • You're invested in raising the bar for security across the organisation -  mentoring other engineers and building durable frameworks that help teams ship securely and consistently.


About the team

We are Canva's Security Group, a team dedicated to protecting one of the world's most trusted design platforms and the millions of users who rely on it every day. The AI Security Team works at the forefront of AI, building novel solutions to security risk posed by the rapidly evolvin AI landscape. As Canva scales globally and integrates cutting-edge AI capabilities, we're evolving our security posture to stay ahead of emerging risks across all of Canva. We combine technical excellence with collaborative problem-solving, ensuring that security is embedded in everything we do. Our work directly enables Canva's mission to empower the world to design, keeping our platform secure, resilient, and trustworthy.

What's in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

Here's a taste of what's on offer:

  • Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too

  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers

  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more

  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

Other stuff to know

We see AI as a powerful amplifier of creativity and technology at Canva. We’re evolving how we assess AI skills in our Technology hiring experience - you’ll tackle interactive, real-time challenges that reflect the kind of work we do. In some interviews, you may also be asked to solve a problem using an AI tool to show how you approach challenges with tech by your side. Your recruitment partner will walk you through what to expect.

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above - we still want to hear from you!

jobDescription.text:
Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

What you’d be doing in this role

As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.

This Staff Software Engineer role sits at the centre of the biggest re-architecture in Canva's mobile history. Canva's mobile app has, until now, been a browser wrapped around web code. That's changing. The Portable Platform is Canva's move to a native-grade mobile experience — write once, deploy across iOS, Android, and web. Very few companies have attempted a migration at this scale, and almost none have had to rebuild the tooling and testing infrastructure that makes it possible at the same time.

Mobile Workflows is the newly formed team that owns that infrastructure layer. Three pieces that were previously fragmented across multiple teams; mobile development tooling, the automation testing pipeline, and quality strategy, now have a single home. This role sets the technical direction for all of it.

Within 12 months, the goal is clear: Canva has a unified mobile development workflow strategy owned by one team. Automation testing ownership models are rolled out. Shared quality signals are holding product teams accountable. Your contribution will be making the testing and tooling infrastructure that hundreds of engineers depend on, becomes coherent and reliable.

At the moment, this role is focused on:

  • Own mobile development tooling. Architecture and roadmap for simulator and emulator setup, device orchestration, and CLI tools across iOS and Android — making the engineering trade-offs that balance short and long-term needs.

  • Lead the test automation framework. Design and evolve the mobile test automation framework for synthetic and integration testing across platforms, scoping problems across teams and delivering projects that span multiple consuming teams.

  • Set the CI/CD quality gating strategy. Proactively surface quality problems not yet defined by others. Protect Canva's longer-term mobile goals by getting ahead of issues before they land in production.

  • Consolidate what's fragmented. Drive alignment across Native Infra, Cross Platform, and DevX to bring fragmented mobile workflows into one cohesive system. Manage the complexity of multiple stakeholders and keep teams moving toward shared goals.

  • Codify the standards. Define and publish mobile testing best practices and methodologies across Canva. Your documentation becomes the reference other engineers build on — not just on this team, but company-wide.

  • Build shared quality signals. Create company-wide triage workflows and monitoring for mobile development and testing. Set clear objectives and empower teams to own delivery and quality themselves.

  • Mentor and grow the team. Rally mobile teams around a shared mission and ways of working. Give direct, actionable feedback and help attract and assess top mobile talent alongside the hiring manager.

You're probably a match if

We'd love to hear from you if you fit one or more of these:

(You don’t need meet fit all of these, but the more the better, and if you join our team we’re invested in helping you grow)

  • Mobile Platform Depth: Deep expertise in at least one mobile platform iOS (Swift) or Android (Kotlin) with working knowledge of the other and genuine experience with cross-platform approaches.

  • Cross-Platform Development: Hands-on experience with React Native or a comparable cross-platform mobile framework, used in a production environment at meaningful scale.

  • Testing Infrastructure Ownership: Experience building or significantly shaping a mobile test automation framework — synthetic, integration, or E2E — with evidence that other teams adopted what you built.

  • CI/CD Strategy: Background in defining quality gating strategy or improving CI/CD pipelines. You've thought about mobile build systems, device farm integration, and what fast, reliable feedback loops look like at scale.

  • Delivery at Scale: Track record of scoping and delivering complex, cross-team technical projects. You know what it takes to ship something that spans multiple stakeholders and still lands cleanly.

  • Alignment Without Authority: Skilled at driving technical direction with teams you don't manage. You build buy-in through credibility and clear communication, not through hierarchy.

  • Standards Setting: Your technical docs and practices have become the reference others build on. You write for the reader who hasn't met you yet.

  • Strategic and Tactical: You can hold the 12-month horizon and the current sprint at the same time. 

Nice to have:

  • Device Farm Experience: Hands-on with BrowserStack, Firebase Test Lab, or similar cloud device testing platforms.

  • Bazel Familiarity: Experience working within a Bazel-based monorepo CI/CD environment, particularly at scale.

  • Platform Transition Experience: You've helped a team migrate from one mobile paradigm to another — WebView to native, or web-first to cross-platform — and lived through the tooling challenges that come with it.

  • Stakeholder Influence: Background in internal advocacy or technical communication across engineering organisations.

About the Group and Team

Mobile Platform's mission is to provide optimal platform support for mobile development, from ideation to deployment. The subgroup sits within Canva's Product Platform supergroup alongside Client Platform, User Platform, API Platform, and PIE. It currently has two established teams — Cross Platform and Native Infra — and Mobile Workflows is the newest addition.

As product engineers shift from web-only to cross-platform development under the Portable Platform, they need tooling and testing infrastructure that keeps up. The decisions made here will shape how hundreds of engineers ship mobile at Canva for years.

  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers

  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more

  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally

Other stuff to know?

We see AI as a powerful amplifier of creativity and technology at Canva. We're evolving how we assess AI skills in our Technology hiring experience — you'll tackle interactive, real-time challenges that reflect the kind of work we do. In some interviews, you may also be asked to solve a problem using an AI tool to show how you approach challenges with tech by your side.

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture.

When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva, so even if you don't feel like your skills quite match what's listed above — we still want to hear from you!

Description

Join the team redefining how the world experiences design

Hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where and How You Can Work
This role is based in Milan, with a hybrid working arrangement. Our Milan hub is a place for collaboration and creative energy and we want you close enough to the Italian market to genuinely feel it. You'll have the flexibility to work in a way that suits you, with meaningful time in the office to connect with the team.

About the Role
As the Creative Strategist for Italy, you'll be the creative performance engine behind Canva's paid and organic marketing in the region — working at the intersection of data, storytelling, and cultural nuance to drive real user growth. This is a hands-on, insight-led role where local knowledge, analytical curiosity, and creative excellence drive outcomes. You won't manage a direct team, but you'll have real influence — over creative direction, agency partners, and the cross-functional teams who help bring ideas to life.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the creative flywheel — own the full creative cycle (research, briefing, production, editing, and analysis), driving sprint cycles with regional and global teams and developing testable ideas grounded in user insights
  • Analyse and optimise performance — dig into dashboards to spot winners, diagnose underperformance, and design creative tests, lift studies, and attribution experiments in close partnership with analytics teams
  • Lead organic and paid social creative strategy — define what high-performing creative looks like for Italian audiences across Meta, TikTok, Instagram, and emerging platforms, building content systems informed by performance data and local cultural moments
  • Own UGC, localisation, and market insight — brief and review creator content to ensure it's on-brand and platform-optimised, and bring genuine cultural fluency to every project
  • Work with in-house and agency teams — bridge external creative partners and internal stakeholders, working with media buyers, data science, the Europe Growth Marketing Lead, and agency partners across Brand, Product Growth, and Analytics
  • Support conversion across the funnel — contribute to CRO initiatives to make acquisition journeys seamless, engaging, and high-converting

What We're Looking For
You bring real, hands-on experience in creative strategy or performance marketing and you know what it takes to build creative that actually performs. You understand platform-native formats deeply, you're rigorous about testing, and you use data to sharpen your thinking rather than replace it. You have genuine knowledge of the Italian market — not surface-level familiarity — and you move comfortably between global teams, agency partners, and local execution. You're self-directed, collaborative, and you take ownership of outcomes.

You're Probably a Match If

  • You have extensive experience in growth marketing with a focus on creative strategy across paid and organic social (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram)
  • You have a strong eye for platform-native creative and the frameworks to test, learn, and scale it
  • You're confident using performance dashboards, data tools, and measurement frameworks (including MMM and attribution) to drive decisions
  • You have genuine, deep knowledge of the Italian market and are fluent in Italian and English - additional languages are a bonus
  • You have strong experience briefing and iterating creative in cross-functional sprints
  • You have a growth mindset — analytical, curious, and comfortable with ambiguity

About the Group/Team
Our Europe Marketing Group drives market-specific growth across performance marketing, brand, social, community engagement, and more. We work at the intersection of creativity and data, combining global thinking with genuine local understanding to drive meaningful outcomes in our priority markets. We grow through experimentation, creative excellence, and a deep belief that getting the creative right is the fastest path to sustainable growth.

Other stuff to know
We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don't feel like your skills quite match what's listed above — we still want to hear from you!

Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more details

Description
Join the team empowering the world to design

Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, こんにちは, 你好, hallo, नमस्ते, 안녕하세요, hola, salut!

At Canva, our mission is to empower the world to design—and we’re growing fast across the globe. With over 250 million monthly active users in over 190 countries, we’re on a mission to make Canva the most loved brand in the world. To support this ambition, we’re building a world-class growth marketing team that’s deeply local, highly creative, and relentlessly performance-focused.

We're looking for a Performance Marketing Specialist to join our team in Italy, focused on driving incremental user growth through great investment decisions, media buying strategy and execution, supporting creative and ensuring we send traffic to great post-click experiences.

About the role
As the Performance Marketing Specialist for Italy, you will be the analytical media expert that partners closely with our creative strategist and broader marketing team in Italy to drive great incremental returns on our media investments.

To be successful in this role you will need to understand the modern media measurement toolkit, media buying principles in key channels, what makes creative great in key channels and iteratively improve our funnel experiences.

As part of this role, you will report to Italy, Head of Marketing and work collaboratively with the rest of the marketing team focused on brand campaigns, lifecycle and partnerships for example. You will also help raise the bar in full funnel media management. 

What you'll do

  • Own day to day media buying, optimisation and pacing across multiple channels in Italy. You will focus on creative-led channels ( Meta, YT & TT, LinkedIn) as we have global search and ASO teams supporting Italy
  • Translate Italy priorities into concrete strategy and plans. Set these in partnership with the Global Growth Marketing team and Italy Country Team.
  • Set the media mix, lead budget allocation review processes and own the experiment roadmap.
  • Partner with the Data team to run incrementality studies, interpret and calibrate our MMMs, utilise MMP and platform form data where appropriate.
  • Translate performance data into clear creative insights, sharing learnings with Growth Creative pods that prioritise native vertical video and creator partnerships with embedded Growth Marketers
  • Actively manage creative rotation: scale top-performing assets, pause low performers, and proactively flag refresh needs that shape our creative strategy
  • Evaluate audience segmentation, targeting, and bidding strategies, proposing improvements and experiments across the region
  • Work closely with creative team to maximise Tiktok Content Suite and champion best practices in modern content formats to get and retain attention
  • Level up creative cohort analysis and bring unique insights into how we are running our creative flywheel.
  • Lead formulation, implementation and learning cycles through CRO initatives across channels.
  • Improve performance marketing systems and workflows, with a focus on automation, adopting AI tooling and even building reusable systems

You’re probably a match if you have:

  • Proven hands-on experience in media buying and budget management across major platforms with strong media buying principle understanding.
  • Strong optimisation mindset and confidence making data-driven decisions.
  • Proven experience collaborating with creative teams to improve performance through structured testing and iteration.
  • Cross-channel growth mindset, able to evaluate trade-offs, dynamically shift investment, and prioritise incremental impact.
  • Familiarity with MMM, lift studies, and incrementality testing. Design experiments autonomously and build a strong relationship with the Marketing Science team.
  • Experience with creative testing frameworks or sprint-based experimentation
  • Experience working iteratively with a creative team led by a creative strategist
  • Experience improving funnels into Apps and Web based products.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a remote, multi-market environment.
  • Italian speaking and good English, with a feel for market context.

About the team
You’ll be part of a highly collaborative, fast-moving, and passionate marketing team that blends creativity and data to make magic happen. In this role, you’ll help Canva show up at its best, fuelling growth by bringing performance and creativity together in every campaign.

Other stuff to know
We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don't feel like your skills quite match what's listed above — we still want to hear from you!

Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where and how you can work

Our flagship Sydney campus is uniquely Canva - an extension of our Surry Hills neighbourhood. It’s a thoughtfully designed space with plenty of room to collaborate, focus, and connect.

This role is based in Sydney, and we’re looking for someone who calls it home. Our hybrid way of working gives you the flexibility to work remotely, and to come together on campus for meaningful in-person collaboration and connection when it matters most. We trust our Canvanauts to choose the balance that empowers them and their team to achieve their goals.

About the Role

Canva is looking for a Senior Legal Counsel for our Product and Privacy team; that supports our product and engineering teams to continually and rapidly evolve Canva AI and how it pulls into an ecosystem of tools whilst making them risk aware of applicable privacy, IP, AI, online safety, marketing, accessibility, platform and consumer laws. You will need to have a solid foundation in global laws in these areas and an enthusiasm for emerging and generative AI technologies.

This role is a unique opportunity to join the exciting Product and Privacy function for Canva in Australia and work at the intersection of AI, product counselling, and legal strategy and governance. Your colleagues will be all over the world meaning comfort with time zones is a must!

As Canva scales, change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but will likely evolve.

At the moment, this role Is focused on

  • Identify and advise on legal issues in key areas including privacy, data protection, intellectual property, marketing, online safety, AI regulation, platform, competition, and consumer laws.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders, advising on product development (including agentic and generative AI products), go-to-market strategy, partnership terms, consumer-facing terms and risk mitigation
  • Contribute to the development and operationalization of company-wide AI policies, processes and legal frameworks.
  • Draft and maintain legal playbooks and internal guidance related to AI tools and technologies.
  • Collaborate closely with privacy, IP, security, product and engineering teams.
  • Help build scalable and effective processes for legal review to enable the launch of new products.
  • Participate in the review and coordination of potential privacy or data security incidents (including on call), including investigations, notifications, and other resolution efforts.
  • Stay up to date with global AI and privacy regulations and relevant industry standards.

You're probably a match if

  • Legally qualified (AUS/NZ, UK, EU or US practising certificate)
  • 10+ years practicing law with some experience in-house, preferably in a technology company.
  • Familiarity with key global digital, AI, privacy, consumer and online safety laws and regulations (e.g. EU AI Act, GDPR, ePrivacy Directive, Digital Services Act, Online Safety Act(s)).
  • Deep understanding of modern AI technology and products. You have real opinions on things like generative and agentic AI, and the privacy, IP, safety and regulatory considerations that come with them.
  • You’re comfortable collaborating with team members in other time zones
  • You are a collaborative, pragmatic, business-minded lawyer who wants to help the Canva group grow and be a part of its exciting journey
  • You bring clarity to complexity and simplify compliance without compromising standards
  • You love collaborating with engineers, PMs, and marketers — and thrive in fast-moving environments
  • You’re risk aware, not risk adverse
  • You’re creative, curious, and motivated by meaningful work

Bonus if you have:

  • AI Governance Professional, Certified Information Privacy Professional qualifications highly regarded (and willingness to obtain CIPP certification within 6 months of joining is a must)
  • Knowledge and understanding of Canva
  • High level of comfort with technology and AI experimentation
  • Hands on experience advising rapidly growing technology companies on privacy and product related regulatory requirements.

What's in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity, and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a stack of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

Here's a glimpse into what we offer:

  • Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too
  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers
  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more
  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge, study, and support you personally

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

Other stuff to know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.
