Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Hello, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where and how you can work

Our flagship office is in Sydney, Australia, but we've made our way from down under, to a hub in San Francisco, which is now home to our US operations. We offer flexibility in how and where you work. We trust our Canvanauts to choose the balance that empowers them and their team to achieve their goals.

What you’d be doing in this role

Canva's Partnerships org spans Resellers, Alliances, Agencies, and Growth Partners — and it's one of the biggest levers for our Enterprise Growth. But great partnerships don't run on relationships alone. They run on the systems, processes, and data that make every partner interaction faster, cleaner, and more repeatable at scale. That's what this role is about.

This role will be focused on:

  • Owning Canva's Partner Relationship Management platform (currently Allbound) end-to-end — the architecture, partner experience, integrations, and continuous improvement across all four partnership pillars

  • Assessing current workflows and technology to build a longer term roadmap and vision for platform and process as we scale

  • Managing an onshore/offshore deal registration and order processing team — setting the bar for quality, speed, and accuracy, and building the processes that let the team scale without breaking

  • Designing and running critical commercial processes: solutions engagement workflows, partner referral payments, margin and MDF management across the ecosystem

  • Owning the partner agreements and contract operations process — from initial execution through amendments and renewals — in close partnership with Legal and Finance

  • Leading the infrastructure behind Canva's account mapping and lead-sharing motion — making co-sell actionable and measurable

  • Owning the Partnerships forecast: building the model, tracking coverage and conversion, and giving senior leadership a reliable, data-backed view of partner-sourced revenue

  • Building the reporting and insights layer for the Partnerships org — clear, consistent visibility into pipeline, partner performance, revenue attribution, and program health

  • Owning partner enablement infrastructure in partnership with PMM and Enablement: onboarding journeys, training frameworks, and the systems that get new partners to productivity fast and keep existing partners sharp

  • Partnering with Sales, Operations, Finance, Legal to ensure partner commercial motions run without friction and escalating early when they don't

  • Shaping overall partner program strategy: tier design, program governance, and the framework that determines how Canva invests in and rewards its partner ecosystem

  • Owning partner pipeline hygiene and governance — ensuring partner opportunities are accurate, up to date, consistently managed, and provide reliable visibility for forecasting, reporting, and partner performance.

  • Establishing partner communications governance — ensuring all customer-facing communications and operational touch points are appropriately positioned, partner-aligned, and reinforce Canva's partner sales motions.

  • Designing and scaling partner renewal operations — building repeatable renewal processes, tooling, and governance that drive predictable renewals, reduce operational effort, and deliver a consistent partner experience across the lifecycle.

You're probably a match if

  • You've built or owned the operations layer for a multi-channel partner program at a SaaS company — you've felt the pain of broken deal registration flows and you know how to fix them for good

  • You're fluent in the partner tech stack: PRM platforms, ecosystem tooling like Crossbeam, and the CRM integrations that make it all work together

  • You're equally comfortable getting into the detail of a payment reconciliation and presenting a data-driven view of program health to senior leadership — and you know which one to prioritise when

  • You can hold operational rigour and strategic thinking at the same time: you know what to standardise now and what to build for scale later

  • You've worked across multiple partner types — resellers, agencies, alliances, or ISVs — and you understand that each motion has its own commercial and operational logic

  • You've managed or mentored a team — including distributed teams — and you know how to set clear expectations, coach on quality, and keep people motivated across time zones

  • You're a strong cross-functional operator who has navigated Finance, Legal, RevOps, and Sales to land shared decisions, and you don't need perfect information to move forward


About the team

This role sits within GTM Ops and is the operational backbone of Canva's Partnerships org — spanning Resellers, Alliances, Agencies, and Growth Partners globally. You'll report into the Head of GTM Ops and work closely with the Partnerships leadership team, GTM Operations, Finance, Sales, and Legal. You'll also direct an onshore/offshore deal registration and order processing team, which means you're not just building the systems — you're accountable for the people running them. As Canva's enterprise motion accelerates, the operational foundation you build here will be a direct input to how fast and how well we can scale the ecosystem.

What's in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

Here's a taste of what's on offer:

  • Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too

  • Health benefits plans to support you and your wellbeing

  • 401(k) retirement plan with company contribution

  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers

  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more

  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

Other stuff to know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills, merit and business needs, in compliance with applicable local laws.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above - we still want to hear from you!

When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job descriptions can feel a bit formulaic sometimes, but we promise Canva is anything but. If you're drawn to what we're building and you see yourself in this role, we'd love to hear from you.

Where and How You Can Work The buzzing Canva London campus features several buildings around beautiful leafy Hoxton Square in Shoreditch. While our global headquarters is in Sydney, Australia, London is our HQ for Europe, with all kinds of teams based here, plus event spaces to gather our team and communities. You'll experience a warm welcome from our Vibe team at front of house, amazing home cooked food from our Head Chef and a variety of workspaces to hang out with your team mates or get solo work done. That said, we trust our Canvanauts to choose the balance that empowers them and their team to achieve their goals, so you have choice in where and how you work.

What You'd Be Doing in This Role

Our Account Executives work closely with customers to understand their goals and show them how Canva can help their whole business create and collaborate at scale. As a Mid-Market Account Executive, you'll focus on the DACH region, running a high-velocity, end-to-end sales cycle with a strong focus on new logo attainment.

At the moment, this role is focused on:

  • You'll own a targeted book of German-speaking mid-market prospects and run outbound sales activity to identify, engage, and convert new business.
  • You'll run a full sales cycle from first outreach to close, using the SPICED methodology to qualify opportunities and uncover real customer value.
  • You'll build account plans that are grounded in a data-driven read of the market, translating those plans into targeted, day-to-day sales activity.
  • You'll work closely with your manager and senior Account Executives to sharpen your discovery, pitch, and negotiation skills as you build toward more complex deals.
  • You'll keep accurate, up-to-date records of pipeline, forecasts, and customer interactions in Salesforce.
  • You'll collaborate with Sales & Success, Marketing, and Product to keep the customer experience seamless from first conversation through to close.
  • You'll stay close to trends in the DACH mid-market so you can speak credibly to what's changing in your customers' businesses.

You're Probably a Match If: 

  • You have some experience in outbound sales, ideally in a B2B or SaaS environment, and you're hungry to build a career in mid-market sales.
  • You're a confident, clear communicator in both German and English, and you're comfortable presenting to multiple stakeholders.
  • You're organised and self-motivated, with the discipline to manage a full pipeline and hit consistent activity and conversion targets.

We're the CORE team within the Generative AI supergroup. Our mission is to invent foundational technologies that will power the future of AI-assisted design. From large-scale models to groundbreaking research, our team builds the technical core of Canva’s creative intelligence engine. We collaborate globally to ship research that makes a real impact—from smart editing to AI video tools—at massive scale.

 

About the Role/Specialty

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you’ll lead efforts to scale and optimize the training system for our large-scale multimodal and foundation models. You’ll design distributed training systems using Megatron-LM, NVIDIA NeMo, FSDP, and Triton—pushing the limits of performance across compute, memory, and communication layers. You'll sit at the intersection of systems and AI research, directly shaping how we train the models that will power Canva’s next generation of products.

 

What you’ll do (responsibilities)

  • You’ll design, implement, and optimize large-scale machine learning systems for training
  • You’ll improve all aspects of performance, including GPU utilization, communication overhead, and memory efficiency.
  • You’ll partner with research and modeling teams to align systems with algorithmic needs.
  • You’ll evaluate and apply best practices for distributed training using industry-leading frameworks.
  • You’ll dive deep into low-level optimization, including custom CUDA or Triton kernels.

• • You’ll debug, profile, and fine-tune training workflows to unlock new levels of scalability.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:

We’re looking for a systems-first engineer who thrives in fast-paced, high-impact environments. You're excited by challenges that stretch current boundaries, and you’re a strong collaborator who communicates clearly across domains.

  • Strong background in LLMs, multimodal AI, or diffusion models.
  • Proficiency in Python. Familiarity with a system programming language (e.g. C++ or Rust) is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of PyTorch or JAX as well as libraries such as Megatron-LM, NeMo, or DeepSpeed.
  • Familiarity with common optimization techniques such as FSDP/ZeRO, gradient checkpointing, or low-precision data types.
  • Hands-on experience writing custom GPU kernels in CUDA or Triton.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, incl. full proficiency in English.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
About the Role

As an LLM Agent Research Scientist, you'll define and lead research that pushes the limits of what LLM-powered agents can do. You'll design agent architectures, reasoning and planning methods, tool-use and multi-agent frameworks, and the post-training recipes (including RL) that make agents capable and dependable. You'll also train models with high-end GPUs on large, high-quality datasets. You'll sit at the intersection of frontier research and product, directly shaping how LLM agents transform the way people create and get work done in Canva.

作为大模型智能体研究科学家，你将定义并主导不断突破智能体能力上限的研究。你将设计智能体架构、推理与规划方法、工具调用与多智能体框架，以及让智能体更强大、更可靠的后训练方案（包括 RL）。你也会在大规模、高质量的数据集上，用高端 GPU 训练模型。你将处在前沿研究与产品的交汇点，直接影响大模型智能体如何改变人们在 Canva 上创作与工作的方式。

At the moment, this role is focused on

  • Research Direction: Determining and leading agent research initiatives aligned with the frontier of LLM/agent research and Canva's product goals.

  • Model Innovation: Creating novel agent capabilities through post-training and RL—developing reward modeling, synthetic data, and environment design—and running experiments with high-end GPUs on large, high-quality datasets to validate hypotheses and translate results into shippable improvements.

  • Harness Innovation: Designing and building the agent harness that lets agents execute complex, long-horizon tasks reliably in production, and exploring harness techniques for self-improvement.

  • Evaluation: Creating rigorous benchmarks and evaluation methods for agent correctness, safety, robustness, and real-world task success.

  • Product Impact: Partnering closely with engineering, product, design, and data teams to land frontier research capabilities in real Canva product experiences.

  • 研究方向：定义并主导契合大模型/智能体研究前沿与 Canva 产品目标的研究方向。

  • 模型创新：通过后训练和 RL 打造全新的智能体能力——涵盖 reward modeling、合成数据、环境设计等——并在大规模、高质量数据集上用高端 GPU 开展实验，验证假设，把结果转化为可落地的改进。

  • Harness 创新：设计并构建 agent harness，让智能体能在生产环境中稳定地完成复杂的长链路任务，并探索让智能体自我改进的 harness 技术。

  • 评测：围绕智能体的正确性、安全性、鲁棒性和真实任务完成情况，构建严谨的基准与评测方法。

  • 产品影响：与工程、产品、设计和数据团队紧密协作，将前沿研究能力落地到真实的 Canva 产品体验中。

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
You're probabaly a match if you have:

  • Rich, hands-on experience developing and iterating on LLM-based agents or foundation models—covering areas such as post-training, RL, reward modeling, synthetic data, or agent environment design.

  • A strong academic and professional track record, including peer-reviewed publications at top-tier venues such as NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR/ACL/EMNLP/CVPR and/or impactful open-source contributions.

  • Proficiency in Python and PyTorch, with familiarity in frameworks and libraries such as Transformers, DeepSpeed, Megatron, and agent/RL frameworks, as well as cloud computing platforms for efficient training and deployment.

  • Curiosity! Always looking to stay ahead of industry trends by tracking AI literature, competitors, and emerging technologies.

  • 在研发和迭代大模型智能体或基础模型方面有丰富的实战经验——涵盖后训练、RL、reward modeling、合成数据或智能体环境设计等方向。

  • 扎实的学术与专业履历，例如在 NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR/ACL/EMNLP/CVPR 等顶级会议发表过学术论文，或有过有影响力的开源贡献。

  • 精通 Python 和 PyTorch，熟悉 Transformers、DeepSpeed、Megatron 及 agent/RL 框架等工具库，以及用于高效训练和部署的云计算平台。

  • 好奇心！始终关注行业动态，通过追踪 AI 文献、竞品和新兴技术保持领先。

companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
About the team

The International Supergroup Group within the Growth Org exists to empower Canva to win locally at global scale. We combine global product excellence with deep local market insight to unlock growth across regions.

We operate like founders in every market, obsessing over users, acting with urgency, and partnering across Product, Marketing, Content, Education and B2B to build locally relevant strategies. We move fast, think long-term, and bring together diverse global teams to deliver measurable impact.

As we scale, regional leadership becomes critical — ensuring alignment, focus, and ambitious execution across multiple markets simultaneously.

About the role

As the executive owner of Canva’s growth strategy across LATAM, this is a high-impact leadership role accountable for delivering sustainable step-change growth across LATAM, by building a portfolio of winning markets, making every Country Manager successful, and driving execution at speed.

You are the regional GM: setting the growth vision, owning the P&L, making capital-allocation calls and serving as the two-way translator between country teams and Canva's central functions.

You are Canva's bridge between the ground and global. You champion local needs (with data) into central Product, Marketing, Content, Localisation, and Finance. You turn central resources into local wins for your CMs. When country teams can't access central capability, or when central teams don't understand what LATAM actually needs, that is your problem to solve.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
What you’ll do

  • Set and own the multi-year LATAM growth strategy across users, revenue, and market expansion. Own the regional P&L along with regional forecasting, budget allocation, and investment trade-offs with strong commercial discipline.

  • Lead, develop, and hold accountable Country Leads across Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, and the wider region (frontiers). Own internal comms and be the executive escalation point for complex challenges; resolve blockers within 48 hours.

  • Be the two-way translator between LATAM country teams and global functions (Product, Marketing, Content, Localisation, Finance). Champion local needs with data; turn central resources into competitive advantages for your markets.

  • Champion localisation across product, pricing, packaging, partnerships, and messaging. Own content and marketing accountability for the region.

  • Represent Canva externally across LATAM: press, enterprise, government, ecosystem partnerships, and events.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
Who we're looking for

We’re looking for a regional leader who combines founder mentality with executive maturity.

  • You've personally driven out-sided results. You can name a specific market, a strategy or pivot where things turned, and your fingerprints are on it.

  • You've built and led other leaders. Country GMs, regional directors, or equivalent. You know what great looks like at that level and you’ve coached people to it.

  • You've stabilised or turned around a market, not just grown one. You've walked into something hard: underperforming metrics, a market that needed a reset and you worked it to success systematically.

  • You let the data lead. Your recommendations come with numbers. You can read a P&L and make real resource calls from it. You know your unit economics.

  • You actually use the product. You care about craft, not just the commercial outcome. You have genuine opinions about what makes Canva great and where it could be better. You can hold a real conversation with a PM.

  • You get things done through influence. You're effective with global central teams, not worn down by them. You build support rather than demand it.

  • You have real LATAM depth. PT/ES fluency. Real customer and cultural exposure across Brazil and at least one other major LATAM market. You understand what's genuinely different about building and selling here, not just in theory.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Description

Join the team empowering the world to design

Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, こんにちは, 你好, hallo, नमस्ते, 안녕하세요, hola, salut!

At Canva, our mission is to empower the world to design—and we’re growing fast across the globe. With over 250 million monthly active users in over 190 countries, we’re on a mission to make Canva the most loved brand in the world. To support this ambition, we’re building a world-class growth marketing team that’s deeply local, highly creative, and relentlessly performance-focused.

We're looking for a Performance Marketing Specialist to join our team in France, focused on driving incremental user growth through great investment decisions, media buying strategy and execution, supporting creative and ensuring we send traffic to great post-click experiences.

About the role

As the Performance Marketing Specialist for France, you will be the analytical media expert that partners closely with our creative strategist and broader marketing team in France to drive great incremental returns on our media investments.

To be successful in this role you will need to understand the modern media measurement toolkit, media buying principles in key channels, what makes creative great in key channels and iteratively improve our funnel experiences.

As part of this role, you will work collaboratively with the rest of the marketing team focused on brand campaigns, lifecycle and partnerships for example. You will also help raise the bar in full funnel media management. 

What you'll do

  • Own day to day media buying, optimisation and pacing across multiple channels in France. You will focus on creative-led channels ( Meta, YT & TT, LinkedIn) as we have global search and ASO teams supporting France

  • Translate France priorities into concrete strategy and plans. Set these in partnership with the Global Growth Marketing team and France Country Team.

  • Set the media mix, lead budget allocation review processes and own the experiment roadmap.

  • Partner with the Data team to run incrementality studies, interpret and calibrate our MMMs, utilise MMP and platform form data where appropriate.

  • Translate performance data into clear creative insights, sharing learnings with Growth Creative pods that prioritise native vertical video and creator partnerships with embedded Growth Marketers.

  • Actively manage creative rotation: scale top-performing assets, pause low performers, and proactively flag refresh needs that shape our creative strategy.

  • Evaluate audience segmentation, targeting, and bidding strategies, proposing improvements and experiments across the region.

  • Work closely with creative team to maximise Tiktok Content Suite and champion best practices in modern content formats to get and retain attention.

  • Level up creative cohort analysis and bring unique insights into how we are running our creative flywheel.

  • Lead formulation, implementation and learning cycles through CRO initatives across channels.

  • Improve performance marketing systems and workflows, with a focus on automation, adopting AI tooling and even building reusable systems

You’re probably a match if you have:

  • Proven hands-on experience in media buying and budget management across major platforms with strong media buying principle understanding.

  • Strong optimisation mindset and confidence making data-driven decisions.

  • Proven experience collaborating with creative teams to improve performance through structured testing and iteration.

  • Cross-channel growth mindset, able to evaluate trade-offs, dynamically shift investment, and prioritise incremental impact.

  • Familiarity with MMM, lift studies, and incrementality testing. Design experiments autonomously and build a strong relationship with the Marketing Science team.

  • Experience with creative testing frameworks or sprint-based experimentation.

  • Experience working iteratively with a creative team led by a creative strategist

  • Experience improving funnels into Apps and Web based products.

  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a remote, multi-market environment.

  • French and good English, with a feel for market context.

About the team

You’ll be part of a highly collaborative, fast-moving, and passionate marketing team that blends creativity and data to make magic happen. In this role, you’ll help Canva show up at its best, fuelling growth by bringing performance and creativity together in every campaign.

What’s in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

Here's a taste of what's on offer:

  • Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too

  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers

  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more

  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where and how you can work

This role is based at our Manila campus and follows a hybrid way of working. You have choice in where and how you work. We trust our Canvanauts to choose the balance that empowers them and their team to achieve their goals.

The Opportunity

At Canva, we’re building the world’s most empowering design platform and that starts with our people.

We’re looking for a Regional People Lead to own the people agenda across South East Asia. This role is for someone who thrives at the intersection of global strategy and local reality; someone who can translate, adapt, and embed people initiatives in a way that works for our teams on the ground, while building strong connections back to our global People function.

South East Asia is Canva’s largest region outside of ANZ, with ~900 Canvanauts across the Philippines, Indonesia, Thailand and Vietnam, representing ~20% of our global team. Each market brings its own regulatory environment, cultural nuance, and organisational dynamics. You'll bring deep knowledge of all of that to make Canva a better place to work across the region.

You'll lead a small, high-impact team of four across People Partnering, People Relations, and Location Partners and hold a client group of your own, keeping you grounded in the day-to-day reality of the business.

What You'll Do

Bridge Global and Local

    • Adapt and operationalise global People initiatives for the region, ensuring they're effective, locally relevant, and compliant.

    • Pressure-test whether global approaches will land well in SEA, flag gaps early, and shape how changes are communicated and implemented on the ground.

    • Feed regional trends, risks, and opportunities back to HQ so our global strategy stays grounded in local reality.

HR Business Partnering

    • Provide targeted People Partnering support to a defined client group within the region.

    • Support local org design and reorgs, total rewards benchmarking, country expansion, and the rollout of people initiatives and programs.

    • Be the in-timezone, trusted partner for sensitive people matters and complex regional challenges.

Compliance, Risk & Local Expertise

    • Own regional employment compliance and people risk in partnership with Location Partners and Employment Legal.

    • Be the regional subject matter expert on local legislation, regulation, and cultural nuance across SEA's diverse markets.

    • Act as the escalation point for complex employee relations matters and lead the response to critical regional events such as natural disasters, safety incidents, or major regulatory shifts.

    • Deeply understand the benefit offering across each country consulting on local benefit gaps that impact talent attraction and retention where COEs may not have full visibility.

Culture & Community

    • Help scale Canva’s culture in a way that feels locally authentic and inclusive.

    • Monitor engagement and organisational health across the region, using people data and insights to improve engagement, retention, and employee experience.

    • Support regional connection, events, and leadership presence.

Regional People Leadership

    • Lead and develop a team of four across People Partnering, People Relations, and Location Partners.

    • Set regional priorities, ensure clear ownership across the People ecosystem, and coach your team to thrive in a matrixed, global environment.

    • Provide leadership and connection for the local People team, drive alignment and connection across different People functions to ensure cohesive delivery.

What you bring

  • Proven experience as a senior HR Business Partner in a complex, global environment

  • Deep knowledge of the Philippines, and ideally South East Asia, employment landscape including regulatory requirements, cultural nuance, and local market dynamics

  • Track record of leading and developing People teams, including across dotted-line and matrixed relationships

  • Strong judgement in navigating ambiguity and complex, sensitive people decisions

  • Ability to influence without authority and build trust with senior leaders

  • Comfortable operating with significant autonomy while knowing when to bring others in

  • A pragmatic, thoughtful approach with a genuine bias for action

What’s in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard — and we do — but you’ll also experience moments of connection, impact, and growth along the way.

  • Equity packages — we want our success to be yours too
  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers
  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing and personal growth
  • Flexible leave options to recharge and be a force for good
  • Exposure to global teams and cross-functional leaders as we scale toward 1 billion users

Other stuff to know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion — and how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva — even if you don’t feel like you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you.

Please note that interviews are conducted virtually

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where and how you can work

Alongside our global campuses, we also collaborate with talented contractors and freelancers from all over the world to help us achieve our crazy big goals. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role we’re focusing on Mexico City, Mexico, so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.

This role is a 12-month engagement, working full-time hours.

What you’d be doing in this role

As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.

At the moment, this role is focused on:

  • Partnering with the Country Localisation Lead to shape Canva’s voice across all areas of the product in Spanish (MX)
  • Translating and reviewing key product and marketing content while managing relationships with localisation partners and vendors
  • Developing and maintaining style guides, glossaries, and translation memories to ensure consistency and quality
  • Providing cultural insights and localisation recommendations to improve the user experience for Mexican audiences
  • Assessing machine translation and AI-generated language outputs to maintain high-quality local experiences
  • Collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders across marketing, subscriptions, content, and localisation to deliver impactful initiatives
  • Identifying opportunities to improve localisation workflows, tooling, and quality processes at scale

You're probably a match if:

  • You’re an exceptional writer and communicator in Spanish (MX), with a strong understanding of tone, localisation, and cultural nuance
  • You’re passionate about language, creativity, and helping users experience products in a way that feels natural and empowering
  • You thrive in fast-moving, entrepreneurial environments and enjoy taking ownership of projects and outcomes
  • You have experience working with CAT tools and localisation platforms (experience with Smartling is a bonus)
  • You bring strong attention to detail and can confidently review, evaluate, and improve translated content
  • You enjoy collaborating cross-functionally and building relationships with stakeholders across different teams
  • Bonus points if you have experience with SaaS localisation, SEO, copywriting, or design tools like Canva

About the team

In Mexico, our mission is to empower all Mexican people to design and to make Canva one of the most loved and culturally iconic brands in the country. We see an enormous opportunity to accelerate Mexico’s creative economy, uplift millions of creators, and position Mexico as a regional creative hub.

As part of Canva’s International team, you’ll help shape experiences that resonate deeply with local communities while contributing to Canva’s crazy big goals globally.

Other stuff to know

We make hiring decisions to engage contractors based on your experience, skills and passion. When you signify interest in the Project, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the contractor-accreditation interview process.

Please note that contractor-accreditation meetings are conducted virtually.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above - we still want to hear from you!

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
Empower the World to Design!

전 세계 2억 명 이상이 사용하는 올인원 비주얼 커뮤니케이션 플랫폼 Canva.

Canva는 디자인, 프레젠테이션, 문서, 영상, 웹사이트, AI 기반 콘텐츠 제작까지 하나의 플랫폼에서 제공하며 누구나 아이디어를 현실로 만들 수 있도록 돕고 있습니다.

Canva Korea는 한국 사용자들이 더욱 쉽고 효과적으로 Canva를 활용할 수 있도록 현지 시장에 최적화된 콘텐츠와 경험을 만들어가고 있습니다.

팀 소개

International SEO Team은 Canva 웹사이트의 비로그인 영역에 대한 검색 성과를 향상시키고 전 세계 사용자가 Canva를 발견할 수 있도록 돕고 있습니다.

우리는 키워드 리서치, 테크니컬 SEO, 콘텐츠 전략, 아웃리치, 엔지니어링, 데이터 분석, 디자인, 운영 등 다양한 전문성을 가진 글로벌 팀으로 구성되어 있습니다. 검증된 글로벌 SEO 프레임워크와 각 시장의 로컬 인사이트를 결합하여 Canva의 글로벌 성장을 이끌고 있습니다.

포지션 소개

Canva의 SEO는 세계 최고 수준입니다. 우리는 한국 시장에서 콘텐츠를 통한 성장을 직접 만들어갈 SEO Content Specialist를 찾고 있습니다. 이 포지션은 정규직으로, 네이버 생태계를 깊이 이해하고 한국 사용자에게 진정으로 도움이 되는 콘텐츠를 전략적으로 만들어갈 수 있는 분이라면 잘 맞을 것입니다.

네이버 블로그를 직접 운영하며 콘텐츠의 퀄리티와 성과 모두를 책임지고, 프리랜서 카피라이터 팀을 이끌며 한국 시장만의 콘텐츠 전략을 주도해나가게 됩니다. 단순히 콘텐츠를 '만드는' 것이 아니라, 콘텐츠가 실제 비즈니스 성장으로 이어지는 연결고리를 직접 만들어가는 역할입니다.

한국어 원어민으로서의 언어 감각, 네이버에 대한 깊은 이해, 그리고 콘텐츠 팀을 이끈 경험이 있다면 더욱 좋습니다.



주요 업무

네이버 콘텐츠 & 생태계 운영

  • Canva 네이버 블로그를 핵심 Organic 채널로 전담하여 에디토리얼 품질, 일관성, 성과 전반을 책임집니다.

  • 키워드 리서치와 네이버 플랫폼 특성을 반영한 전략적 에디토리얼 캘린더를 직접 구축하고 운영합니다.

  • 네이버에서 잘 발견될 수 있으면서도 사용자에게 진짜 가치를 주는 한국어 콘텐츠를 기획하고 작성하고 발행합니다.

  • 네이버 카페, 지식iN, 동영상 등 블로그 이외의 네이버 채널로 Canva의 Organic 존재감을 확장합니다.

  • 댓글과 커뮤니티 반응을 관리하며 Canva에 대한 신뢰와 브랜드 인지도를 쌓아갑니다.

  • 콘텐츠 성과와 가시성을 꾸준히 분석하고, 데이터를 바탕으로 에디토리얼 전략을 계속 발전시킵니다.

웹사이트 콘텐츠 & 최적화

  • 랜딩 페이지와 블로그 아티클의 콘텐츠 방향을 주도하고, 장기적인 콘텐츠 전략 수립에 기여합니다.

  • 한국 시장에서 Canva의 트래픽 점유율을 높일 수 있는 키워드 기회와 콘텐츠 공백을 발굴합니다.

  • 한국 사용자에게 공감되는 다양한 디자인 주제의 SEO 최적화 콘텐츠를 직접 작성하고 편집합니다.

  • 최신 SEO 기준과 현지 톤앤보이스에 맞춰 콘텐츠를 업로드하고 발행합니다.

  • 랜딩 페이지를 정기적으로 점검하고 최적화하여 콘텐츠의 신선도와 사용자 참여도를 유지합니다.

  • CMS, 번역 품질, 페이지 레이아웃에 대한 실질적인 피드백으로 전반적인 품질을 높여갑니다.

협업 & 전략적 파트너십

  • 한국 SEO 팀 전체와 긴밀히 협업하며 목표와 우선순위, SEO 전략을 함께 맞춰갑니다.

  • 키워드 리서치, 경쟁사 분석, SEO Generalist와의 협업 등 다양한 SEO 활동에 기여합니다.

  • 마케팅, 커뮤니티 팀과 협력하여 콘텐츠 전략이 현지 시장의 흐름과 사용자 니즈를 반영하도록 합니다.

  • 현지 시장 인사이트와 사용자 데이터를 팀과 공유하여 콘텐츠 방향 결정에 기여합니다.

  • 다양한 팀과 관계를 형성하며 콘텐츠 업무가 더 넓은 비즈니스 목표에 어떻게 기여하는지 이해합니다.

검색 & Discovery의 변화에 앞서가기

  • ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews 등 AI 기반 플랫폼이 검색 방식을 어떻게 바꾸고 있는지 한국 시장의 시각으로 꾸준히 파악합니다.

  • 전통적인 SEO가 여전히 효과적인 영역과 새로운 접근이 필요한 영역을 구분해 전략적으로 대응합니다.

  • GEO/AEO 등 차세대 최적화 트렌드를 학습하고 팀의 전략에 반영합니다.

  • 검색 환경의 변화에 맞춰 새로운 콘텐츠 포맷과 최적화 방식을 실험하는 것을 즐깁니다.

  • 한국 사용자들이 콘텐츠를 어떻게 발견하는지에 대한 관찰과 인사이트를 글로벌 팀과 공유합니다.

프리랜서 카피라이터 팀 구축 & 운영

  • 퀄리티를 유지하면서 콘텐츠 생산 규모를 확장할 수 있도록 프리랜서 카피라이터 풀을 구축하고 운영합니다.

  • Canva의 브랜드 보이스와 SEO 기준에 맞게 카피라이터를 채용하고 온보딩하고 교육합니다.

  • 카피라이터가 높은 퀄리티의 콘텐츠를 효율적으로 납품할 수 있도록 명확한 브리프를 작성합니다.

  • 카피라이터가 더 잘 성장할 수 있도록 구체적이고 건설적인 피드백과 코칭을 제공합니다.

  • 카피라이터가 자신의 영역에서 Ownership을 갖되, 품질과 마감 기준은 함께 지켜나갑니다.

  • 발행 전 프리랜서 콘텐츠가 Canva의 기준을 충족하는지 확인하는 QA 프로세스를 만들고 운영합니다.

  • 카피라이터들이 충분한 지원을 받고 있다고 느끼며 최선을 다할 수 있는 환경을 만들어갑니다.

AI 기반 업무 효율화

  • 리서치, 콘텐츠 초안, 워크플로우 전반에 AI 툴을 적극적으로 활용합니다.

  • 기존 워크플로우에서 비효율적인 부분을 발견하고 AI 기반으로 개선을 주도합니다.

  • 새로운 AI 툴을 직접 탐색하고 효과적인 사례를 팀 전체와 공유합니다.

이런 분을 찾고 있어요

핵심 역량 & 경험

  • 5년 이상의 SEO, Content Marketing 및/또는 Digital Marketing 관련 경력

  • 한국어 원어민 수준의 커뮤니케이션 역량과 비즈니스 영어 활용 능력

  • SEO 콘텐츠 작성 또는 콘텐츠 마케팅 실무 경험과 성과를 보여주는 포트폴리오

  • 다른 작가에게 피드백을 준 경험을 포함한 탄탄한 카피라이팅 및 카피 에디팅 역량

  • 네이버 콘텐츠의 구조, 가독성, 내러티브 흐름에 대한 깊은 이해

  • 키워드 리서치와 네이버 플랫폼 인사이트를 바탕으로 에디토리얼 캘린더를 기획하고 운영한 경험

  • 다른 작가나 프리랜서를 관리하거나 코칭한 경험

  • CMS에서 콘텐츠를 직접 게시한 경험

  • 키워드 최적화, 콘텐츠 구조, 사용자 의도에 대한 탄탄한 SEO 기본기

  • Ahrefs, Semrush, 블랙키위 등 SEO 툴 활용 경험

  • 웹 분석 툴로 콘텐츠 성과를 측정하고 개선한 경험

  • 가이드라인을 정확히 따르고 품질 기준을 놓치지 않는 꼼꼼함

  • 여러 우선순위를 스스로 관리하고 마감을 지키는 시간 관리 능력

문화적 & 시장 이해

  • 언어 능력을 넘어 한국 사용자에 대한 깊은 이해를 바탕으로 공감할 수 있는 콘텐츠를 만들어낼 수 있는 분

  • 번역된 콘텐츠가 아닌, 처음부터 한국 사용자를 위해 작성된 것처럼 자연스럽고 현지화된 콘텐츠를 만들 수 있는 분

  • 글로벌 관점만으로는 발견하기 어려운 한국 시장만의 인사이트와 성장 기회를 발굴할 수 있는 분

협업 & 커뮤니케이션

  • 명확하고 선제적이며 투명하게 소통할 수 있는 분

  • 다양한 이해관계자와 자연스럽게 관계를 형성하고 협업을 이끌어갈 수 있는 분

  • 피드백을 주고받는 과정을 성장의 기회로 받아들이는 분

미래 지향적인 마인드셋

  • 콘텐츠 자체를 넘어 비즈니스 성과를 바라보고, Organic 트래픽이 전환과 성장으로 이어지는 과정을 이해할 수 있는 분

  • 콘텐츠와 페이지 경험이 사용자 행동에 미치는 영향에 관심이 많고, CRO 관점을 최적화 업무에 반영할 수 있는 분

  • 결과물(Output)보다 실제 성과(Outcome)를 중요하게 생각하며, 한국 시장에서 의미 있는 변화를 만들어내는 데 책임감을 갖는 분

  • AI 검색, LLM, 소셜 검색 등 변화하는 Discovery 환경을 적극적으로 탐구하고 새로운 접근 방식을 실험하는 것을 즐기는 분

  • SEO를 다양한 채널에서의 발견 가능성(Discoverability)의 관점으로 이해하고, 채널에 구애받지 않는 사고방식을 갖춘 분

  • Canva가 새로운 Discovery 채널에서 어떻게 발견되고 있는지 스스로 탐구하고 인사이트와 아이디어를 제안하는 분

이런 경험이 있다면 더욱 좋아요

  • SEO 전략 수립 및 기획 실무 경험

  • 네이버 블로그 또는 유사한 채널을 직접 운영하며 성과를 만든 경험

  • 네이버 카페, 지식iN, 클립·TV 등 다양한 네이버 서피스를 활용한 경험

  • YouTube SEO 및 동영상 콘텐츠 Discovery에 대한 이해

Canva에서 함께 성장해요

  • 구글과 네이버를 아우르는 콘텐츠 SEO 역량을 실전에서 쌓을 수 있습니다.

  • 글로벌 SEO 모범 사례를 배우고 이를 한국 시장에 맞게 발전시키는 경험을 합니다.

  • 여러 검색 엔진의 데이터를 분석하고 사용자 행동을 해석하는 능력을 키웁니다.

  • 세계 최고 수준의 글로벌 SEO 전문가들과 함께 전략적 사고를 발전시킵니다.

  • 한국 시장에서 특히 가치 있는 역량, 네이버 콘텐츠 생태계에 대한 깊은 전문성을 쌓습니다.

  • 콘텐츠와 오가닉 검색 분야에서 장기적으로 성장할 수 있는 탄탄한 기반을 마련합니다.

Canva가 생각하는 인재상

  • 전략적 사고: 주어진 업무를 넘어 목적과 배경을 이해하며 일하는 분

  • 협업: 함께 일하는 사람들과 신뢰를 쌓고 원활한 협업을 만들어가는 분

  • 문제 해결: 어려운 상황에서도 해결책을 찾고 실행으로 옮길 수 있는 분

  • 데이터 기반 사고: 데이터와 인사이트를 바탕으로 의사결정하는 분

  • 주인의식: 맡은 업무에 책임감을 가지고 끝까지 추진하는 분

  • 성장 지향: 배우고 성장하는 과정을 즐기며 지속적으로 발전하는 분

 

About the role

As Canva scales, change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.

Canva's SEO is world-class, and we're looking for a passionate SEO Content Specialist to join the International SEO team to help scale our next phase of growth in South Korea! This is a permanent contract, working [full-time - 40 hours per week].

The SEO Content Specialist will work closely with the Korea SEO Lead and local team. The role of an SEO Content Specialist is to create and manage engaging, SEO-optimized copy and content that informs, inspires, and converts local audiences.

As an SEO Content Specialist, you will provide initiative, direction, and support to create helpful and culturally relevant content for users in the South Korean market. Ideally, you are a native speaker with proficiency in Korean & English.

Canva is a fast-growing, mission-driven company, and we're looking for talented people who want to contribute to something meaningful. If you're excited about the opportunity to make an impact, show us what you've got—strong performers in this role have significant opportunities to grow with us.

About the team

The International SEO team is responsible for improving SEO performance of logged-out pages across the Canva website. Our mission in SEO is to empower every user in the world to discover Canva.

We're a global team of specialists spanning keyword research, technical SEO, content strategy, outreach, engineering, data analytics, design, and operations. We work across many regions and languages, combining proven frameworks with deep local market expertise.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
What you’ll do (responsibilities)

Naver Content & Ecosystem

  • Take full ownership of Canva's Naver Blog as a core organic content channel, with end-to-end responsibility for editorial quality, consistency, and performance
  • Build and maintain a strategically driven editorial calendar informed by keyword research, audience intent, and Naver platform dynamics, with the goal of improving visibility and rankings on Naver
  • Plan, write, edit, and publish high-quality Korean-language content that is optimised for Naver discovery while remaining genuinely valuable for users
  • Expand Canva's organic content presence beyond the Naver Blog by activating and adapting content for other relevant Naver surfaces such as Naver Café, Naver Knowledge iN, and Naver video formats
  • Actively manage and engage with comments and community interactions on Naver to strengthen credibility and user trust
  • Track Naver content performance and visibility, using insights to continuously refine editorial strategy and planning

Website Content & Optimization

  • Champion content requirements for landing pages and blog articles, supporting the development of long-term content strategy by maintaining an up-to-date editorial calendar and publishing plan
  • Identify and prioritise high-opportunity keywords and content gaps to grow Canva's traffic share in the Korean market
  • Create and edit SEO-optimized, engaging content about various design topics that align with the SEO team's content strategy and resonate with local audiences
  • Upload and publish content that follows the latest SEO best practices and fits our local tone of voice (as defined by our language managers)
  • Regularly track and optimize landing pages to maintain freshness, improve content credibility, and enhance user engagement
  • Maintain a high level of quality and consistency in alignment with Canva's brand guidelines
  • Provide feedback on content management systems, translation quality, and page layout to continuously improve efficiency and quality

Collaboration & Strategic Partnership

  • Work closely with the wider Korea SEO team to align on goals, priorities, and SEO best practices that drive growth
  • Support broader SEO activities such as keyword research, competitor analysis, and collaboration with SEO Generalist for content production
  • Collaborate with the country SEO team and broader marketing/community teams to ensure content strategy reflects local market dynamics and user needs
  • Contribute local market intelligence and user insights that inform content priorities and opportunity identification
  • Build relationships across functions to understand how your content work supports broader country initiatives

Navigating the Evolution of Search & Discovery

  • Stay curious about emerging search and discovery trends in your market—including how users find information through AI-powered platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google's AI Overviews, etc.)
  • Understand where traditional SEO drives value versus where new channels and approaches may be more effective in your country
  • Stay up to date on GEO/AEO evolutions and next-generation optimization techniques
  • Be open to experimenting with new content formats and optimization approaches as the search landscape evolves
  • Share observations and learnings about how users in your market discover content, contributing to our global understanding of emerging trends

Copywriter Team Building & Management

  • Build and manage a pool of freelance copywriters to scale content production while maintaining quality standards
  • Hire, onboard, and train copywriters on Canva's brand voice, SEO requirements, and content standards for the Polish market
  • Create clear content briefs that guide copywriters to deliver high-quality, on-brand content efficiently
  • Provide constructive feedback and coaching to help copywriters improve their work and grow their understanding of SEO and Canva's needs
  • Empower copywriters to take ownership of their content areas while maintaining accountability for quality and deadlines
  • Develop a quality assurance process to ensure all freelance-produced content meets Canva's standards before publication
  • Foster collaborative relationships with copywriters, creating an environment where they feel supported and motivated to do their best work

AI-Powered Efficiency

  • Leverage AI tools to enhance research, content drafting, and workflow efficiency
  • Identify inefficiencies in existing workflows and lead improvements through AI-driven solutions
  • Explore and evaluate new AI tools, sharing successful practices and strategies with the wider team

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
What we're looking for

Core Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in SEO, Content Marketing, and/or Digital Marketing
  • Native or near-native proficiency in Korean with business-level English
  • Proven experience in SEO content writing and/or content marketing, with a portfolio demonstrating successful outcomes
  • Strong copywriting and copy editing skills, including experience giving constructive feedback to other writers
  • Deep understanding of Naver's content formats and preferences, including headings, structure, readability, and narrative flow
  • Experience with editorial calendar planning and management based on keyword research, audience intent, and Naver platform insights
  • Experience managing, guiding, or supervising other writers or freelancers (content quality oversight, providing feedback, coaching for improvement)
  • Experience with publishing content in a CMS (content management system)
  • Solid understanding of SEO fundamentals: keyword optimization, content structure, user intent, and how content fits within broader SEO strategy
  • Familiarity with Google & Naver SEO tools like Ahrefs, Semrush, BlackKiwi, or similar platforms (bonus!)
  • Experience using web analytics tools to understand how users engage with content and to measure content performance
  • High attention to detail with the ability to closely follow detailed written instructions and maintain quality standards
  • Strong time management: Ability to self-manage capacity, meet project deadlines, and balance multiple priorities

Cultural & Market Intelligence

  • Deep understanding of local cultural and linguistic nuances that goes beyond language fluency—you know what resonates with audiences in your market
  • Appreciation of local writing trends and content preferences, ensuring content feels native rather than translated
  • Ability to identify opportunities specific to your market that may not be obvious from a global perspective

Collaboration & Communication

  • Excellent communication skills: Clear, proactive, and transparent in both written and verbal communication
  • Collaborative mindset: You build relationships easily, work well across teams, and contribute positively to team culture
  • Willingness to give and receive feedback constructively, always aiming to improve quality and impact

Future-Oriented & Adaptable Mindset

  • Business-driven: you think beyond content for content's sake — you understand how organic traffic connects to conversion and revenue, and use that lens to prioritise what you work on
  • Commercially curious: you naturally factor CRO principles into how you structure, write, and optimise content — from headline framing to page layout to calls to action
  • You set your own bar high: you define success in outcomes, not outputs, and hold yourself accountable to results that move the needle for the Korean market
  • Curiosity about emerging channels: You're actively interested in how discovery is evolving—including AI search, LLMs, social search, and new platforms—and you're eager to learn
  • Comfort with ambiguity: You can experiment with new approaches (like content formatting for AI-generated answers) even when best practices are still being established
  • Channel-agnostic thinking: You understand that "SEO" increasingly means "discoverability"—whether through traditional search engines, AI tools, social platforms, or channels yet to emerge
  • Data-driven adaptability: You can objectively assess what's working and adjust your approach based on performance and market signals
  • Early adopter energy: You're the type of person who's already exploring how Canva appears in new discovery channels, bringing insights and ideas rather than waiting for direction

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in SEO strategy development and planning
  • Hands-on experience running or owning a Naver Blog or a similar owned content channel
  • Experience with other Naver content surfaces such as Naver Café, Naver Knowledge iN, or Naver video formats (e.g. Clip, TV)
  • Familiarity with YouTube SEO and video content discoverability, given YouTube's strong presence in the search landscape

The A-Player Standard

We're setting a high bar—because International is becoming Canva's biggest growth driver, and we need exceptional people driving it.

What "A-Player" means in this role:

  • Strategic thinker: You define what should be done and why (not just execute)
  • Relationship builder: You make collaboration easy and productive
  • Problem solver: You're resourceful and resilient when challenges arise
  • Data-driven: You use insights to drive decisions and demonstrate impact
  • Ownership mindset: You act like it's your business, not just your job
  • Growth-oriented: You're constantly learning, adapting, and improving

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Join the team empowering the world to design

Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, こんにちは, 你好, hallo, नमस्ते, 안녕하세요, hola, salut!

At Canva, our mission is to empower the world to design—and we’re growing fast across the globe. With over 250 million monthly active users in over 190 countries, we’re on a mission to make Canva the most loved brand in the world. To support this ambition, we’re building a world-class growth marketing team that’s deeply local, highly creative, and relentlessly performance-focused.

We're looking for a Performance Marketing Specialist to join our team in Spain, focused on driving incremental user growth through great investment decisions, media buying strategy and execution, supporting creative and ensuring we send traffic to great post-click experiences.

About the role
As the Performance Marketing Specialist for Spain, you will be the analytical media expert that partners closely with our creative strategist and broader marketing team in Spain to drive great incremental returns on our media investments.

To be successful in this role you will need to understand the modern media measurement toolkit, media buying principles in key channels, what makes creative great in key channels and iteratively improve our funnel experiences.

As part of this role, you will report to Spain, Head of Marketing and work collaboratively with the rest of the marketing team focused on brand campaigns, lifecycle and partnerships for example. You will also help raise the bar in full funnel media management. 

What you'll do

  • Own day to day media buying, optimisation and pacing across multiple channels in Spain. You will focus on creative-led channels ( Meta, YT & TT, LinkedIn) as we have global search and ASO teams supporting Spain.

  • Translate Spain priorities into concrete strategy and plans. Set these in partnership with the Global Growth Marketing team and Spain Country Team.

  • Set the media mix, lead budget allocation review processes and own the experiment roadmap.

  • Partner with the Data team to run incrementality studies, interpret and calibrate our MMMs, utilise MMP and platform form data where appropriate.

  • Translate performance data into clear creative insights, sharing learnings with Growth Creative pods that prioritise native vertical video and creator partnerships with embedded Growth Marketers.

  • Actively manage creative rotation: scale top-performing assets, pause low performers, and proactively flag refresh needs that shape our creative strategy.

  • Evaluate audience segmentation, targeting, and bidding strategies, proposing improvements and experiments across the region.

  • Work closely with creative team to maximise Tiktok Content Suite and champion best practices in modern content formats to get and retain attention.

  • Level up creative cohort analysis and bring unique insights into how we are running our creative flywheel.

  • Lead formulation, implementation and learning cycles through CRO initatives across channels.

  • Improve performance marketing systems and workflows, with a focus on automation, adopting AI tooling and even building reusable systems

You’re probably a match if you have:

  • Proven hands-on experience in media buying and budget management across major platforms with strong media buying principle understanding.

  • Strong optimisation mindset and confidence making data-driven decisions.

  • Proven experience collaborating with creative teams to improve performance through structured testing and iteration.

  • Cross-channel growth mindset, able to evaluate trade-offs, dynamically shift investment, and prioritise incremental impact.

  • Familiarity with MMM, lift studies, and incrementality testing. Design experiments autonomously and build a strong relationship with the Marketing Science team.

  • Experience with creative testing frameworks or sprint-based experimentation.

Where and How You Can Work

Our London office is a hub for collaboration and energy — and we believe in working where you do your best thinking. Canva offers flexibility to work in a way that suits you, whether that's remote, hybrid, or in-office.

What You'd Be Doing in This Role

Canva is on a serious growth trajectory in EMEA, and the BDR team is at the heart of it. As we move from being a design tool to an enterprise platform, your role is to open the doors — finding the right companies, sparking the right conversations, and building the pipeline that fuels our next chapter.

At the moment, this role is focused on:

companyDescription.text:
Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where and how you can work

Collingwood is home to our Melbourne campus - a vibrant, creative hub for connection and impactful work. While Sydney is home to our HQ, Melbourne brings its own unique vibe, with local artwork, lush greenery, and thoughtfully designed spaces to help you collaborate, focus, and feel part of a welcoming community.

This role is based in Melbourne, and we’re looking for someone who calls it home. Our hybrid way of working gives you the flexibility to work remotely, and to come together on campus for meaningful in-person collaboration and connection when it matters most.

About the Role

Canva is looking for a Senior Legal Counsel for our Product and Privacy team; that supports our product and engineering teams to continually and rapidly evolve Canva AI and how it pulls into an ecosystem of tools whilst making them risk aware of applicable privacy, IP, AI, online safety, marketing, accessibility, platform and consumer laws. You will need to have a solid foundation in global laws in these areas and an enthusiasm for emerging and generative AI technologies.

This role is a unique opportunity to join the exciting Product and Privacy function for Canva in Australia and work at the intersection of AI, product counselling, and legal strategy and governance. Your colleagues will be all over the world meaning comfort with time zones is a must!

As Canva scales, change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but will likely evolve.

At the moment, this role Is focused on

  • Identify and advise on legal issues in key areas including privacy, data protection, intellectual property, marketing, online safety, AI regulation, platform, competition, and consumer laws.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders, advising on product development (including agentic and generative AI products), go-to-market strategy, partnership terms, consumer-facing terms and risk mitigation
  • Contribute to the development and operationalization of company-wide AI policies, processes and legal frameworks.
  • Draft and maintain legal playbooks and internal guidance related to AI tools and technologies.
  • Collaborate closely with privacy, IP, security, product and engineering teams.
  • Help build scalable and effective processes for legal review to enable the launch of new products.
  • Participate in the review and coordination of potential privacy or data security incidents (including on call), including investigations, notifications, and other resolution efforts.
  • Stay up to date with global AI and privacy regulations and relevant industry standards.

You're probably a match if

  • Legally qualified (AUS/NZ, UK, EU or US practising certificate)
  • 10+ years practicing law with some experience in-house, preferably in a technology company.
  • Familiarity with key global digital, AI, privacy, consumer and online safety laws and regulations (e.g. EU AI Act, GDPR, ePrivacy Directive, Digital Services Act, Online Safety Act(s)).
  • Deep understanding of modern AI technology and products. You have real opinions on things like generative and agentic AI, and the privacy, IP, safety and regulatory considerations that come with them.
  • You’re comfortable collaborating with team members in other time zones
  • You are a collaborative, pragmatic, business-minded lawyer who wants to help the Canva group grow and be a part of its exciting journey
  • You bring clarity to complexity and simplify compliance without compromising standards
  • You love collaborating with engineers, PMs, and marketers — and thrive in fast-moving environments
  • You’re risk aware, not risk adverse
  • You’re creative, curious, and motivated by meaningful work

Bonus if you have:

  • AI Governance Professional, Certified Information Privacy Professional qualifications highly regarded (and willingness to obtain CIPP certification within 6 months of joining is a must)
  • Knowledge and understanding of Canva
  • High level of comfort with technology and AI experimentation
  • Hands on experience advising rapidly growing technology companies on privacy and product related regulatory requirements.

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity, and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a stack of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

jobDescription.text:

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

What you’d be doing in this role

As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.

This Staff Software Engineer role is responsible for driving one of the most exciting changes in Canva's frontend stack and tackling unique technical challenges in the design system domain. The majority of Canva's MAU is now mobile, and we’re evolving our tech stack to catch up. Very few companies have attempted a web to React Native migration at this scale, and fewer design systems get the opportunity to create a “universal” component library that works across both native mobile and web.

We're extending our existing React web component library, which already powers of all of Canva's UI, into a portable React component library that renders via React DOM on web and via React Native on mobile. UI defined once, rendered everywhere. We'll do this by absorbing cross-platform complexity into the design system layer, which means this role is at the frontier of figuring out the right abstractions before product teams ever have to think about them.

This is a high impact role, with multiple prominent Canva surfaces relying on this infrastructure to ship mobile-first experiences before the end of 2026.

  • Own the Portable UI Platform. Ship shared React components across web and React Native that multiple prominent Canva surfaces depend on before end of 2026.

  • Abstract cross-platform complexity. You’ll solve problems once in the platform layer, so product teams get portable-first capability for free.

  • Set the standard: For how portable components are built, distributed, and consumed and design solutions that hold at current and future scale. 800+ engineers will build with it, so it has to be right.

  • Mentor engineers: Through a steep learning curve as the org shifts from web-first to cross-platform. Bring people with you through design and code reviews, team decisions, and the day-to-day.

  • Influence across boundaries: Work with products teams across the company to understand their needs, sequence the work, and decide what belongs in the platform. Adoption is the biggest risk to delivery.

  • Lead strategic technical direction: For the Design System Evolution team, and across the wider design system as needed. We know where we're going; how we get there is yours to figure out.

  • Evolve the design system for an AI-native world: AI-assisted workflows enable faster delivery, empowers non-technical consumers to build UI, and puts a premium on a strong visual language. Seizing the AI opportunity requires changes and investments to our system. You'll help figure out what those are and how to build toward them.

  • Shape frontend engineering at Canva: More broadly, codifying best practices and methodologies, and influencing the frontend specialty.

You're probably a match if

We'd love to hear from you if you fit one or more of these:

(You don’t need meet fit all of these, but the more the better, and if you join our team we’re invested in helping you grow)

  • Design System Leadership: Experience developing or leading a design system, with a passion for platform stewardship and enablement

  • Web Technology Foundations: A deep understanding of the inner workings of fundamental web technologies (HTML, CSS, Web APIs, JS/TS, React)

  • Cross-Platform Development: Hands-on experience with cross-platform and cross-device UI/UX development using React Native

  • Delivery at Scale: Proven track record of shipping large, cross-functional projects across multiple teams with highly reliable, scalable technical solutions

  • Collaboration & Communication: Excellent communicator and collaborator, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams

  • Technical Breadth & Depth: A strong balance between big-picture thinking and meticulous attention to detail

  • Structured Problem Solving: Skilled at breaking down large, ambiguous problems into smaller decisions with clearly identified tradeoffs

  • Culture of Excellence: Passionate about fostering technical excellence, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing within the team and across the specialty

  • AI Curiosity: Open to exploring how AI can improve developer and design workflows

  • Accessibility Awareness: Familiar with accessibility principles, with a genuine commitment to continued learning

Nice to have:

  • Technical Advocacy: Experience championing goals and driving significant technical change — both as a leader and individual contributor

  • Stakeholder Influence: Background in stakeholder communication or internal advocacy

  • Accessible Code: Ability to write accessible code and interpret detailed specifications such as WCAG 2.2 AA

  • Native Development: Exposure to native or hybrid development environments

About the team

A design system is a collection of design guidelines, reusable user interface components, and related resources and tools. Canva has three design system teams working on our shared mission is to build a world-class design system that empowers Canva staff to craft consistent and excellent experiences at scale.

Design System Evolution sits at the frontier of that work. The team's mandate is to evolve and expand design system capabilities to support emerging needs at Canva - expanding the design system’s reach into new surfaces, unlocking new technologies, and setting technical standards for the frontend specialty.

You’ll also sometimes operate at the subgroup level across the 3 design system teams. This is an exciting opportunity for a very experienced engineer who’s passionate about design systems, can balance technical depth with communication and mentorship, and wants the opportunity to play a leading role in taking a design system at Canva’s scale to the next level of maturity.

What's in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

Here's a taste of what's on offer:

  • Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too

  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers

  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more

  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

Other stuff to know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above - we still want to hear from you!

Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

What you’d be doing in this role

As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.

This Staff Software Engineer role is responsible for driving one of the most exciting changes in Canva's frontend stack and tackling unique technical challenges in the design system domain. The majority of Canva's MAU is now mobile, and we’re evolving our tech stack to catch up. Very few companies have attempted a web to React Native migration at this scale, and fewer design systems get the opportunity to create a “universal” component library that works across both native mobile and web.

We're extending our existing React web component library, which already powers of all of Canva's UI, into a portable React component library that renders via React DOM on web and via React Native on mobile. UI defined once, rendered everywhere. We'll do this by absorbing cross-platform complexity into the design system layer, which means this role is at the frontier of figuring out the right abstractions before product teams ever have to think about them.

This is a high impact role, with multiple prominent Canva surfaces relying on this infrastructure to ship mobile-first experiences before the end of 2026.

  • Own the Portable UI Platform. Ship shared React components across web and React Native that multiple prominent Canva surfaces depend on before end of 2026.

  • Abstract cross-platform complexity. You’ll solve problems once in the platform layer, so product teams get portable-first capability for free.

  • Set the standard: For how portable components are built, distributed, and consumed and design solutions that hold at current and future scale. 800+ engineers will build with it, so it has to be right.

  • Mentor engineers: Through a steep learning curve as the org shifts from web-first to cross-platform. Bring people with you through design and code reviews, team decisions, and the day-to-day.

  • Influence across boundaries: Work with products teams across the company to understand their needs, sequence the work, and decide what belongs in the platform. Adoption is the biggest risk to delivery.

  • Lead strategic technical direction: For the Design System Evolution team, and across the wider design system as needed. We know where we're going; how we get there is yours to figure out.

  • Evolve the design system for an AI-native world: AI-assisted workflows enable faster delivery, empowers non-technical consumers to build UI, and puts a premium on a strong visual language. Seizing the AI opportunity requires changes and investments to our system. You'll help figure out what those are and how to build toward them.

  • Shape frontend engineering at Canva: More broadly, codifying best practices and methodologies, and influencing the frontend specialty.

  • Web Technology Foundations: A deep understanding of the inner workings of fundamental web technologies (HTML, CSS, Web APIs, JS/TS, React)

  • Cross-Platform Development: Hands-on experience with cross-platform and cross-device UI/UX development using React Native

  • Delivery at Scale: Proven track record of shipping large, cross-functional projects across multiple teams with highly reliable, scalable technical solutions

A design system is a collection of design guidelines, reusable user interface components, and related resources and tools. Canva has three design system teams working on our shared mission is to build a world-class design system that empowers Canva staff to craft consistent and excellent experiences at scale.

Design System Evolution sits at the frontier of that work. The team's mandate is to evolve and expand design system capabilities to support emerging needs at Canva - expanding the design system’s reach into new surfaces, unlocking new technologies, and setting technical standards for the frontend specialty.

You’ll also sometimes operate at the subgroup level across the 3 design system teams. jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
At Canva, our mission is to empower the world to design. To get cutting-edge research into the hands of millions of users faster, we're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer focused on research enablement and performance, turning promising experiments into stable, scalable, user-facing capabilities while making training and inference faster, cheaper, and more reliable.

About the role:

You'll be the bridge between research and production. Partnering closely with researchers, you'll ensure experimental code is production ready, integrate models into our monorepo, build shared libraries and services, and create the tooling and processes that let multiple model variants ship safely and quickly. You'll also work across the training stack, profiling and tuning PyTorch workloads, improving GPU utilisation, and shaping how we use distributed training and storage to get the most out of our compute. Your work shortens the research-to-user loop, reduces duplication, and ensures our ML features are reliable, observable, and easy for other teams to adopt.

At the moment, this role is focused on:

  • Research-to-Production Pipeline: Hardening experimental models (containerisation, tests, CI/CD), making them deployable for real users.

  • Training Performance and GPU Efficiency: Profiling PyTorch training jobs, improving GPU utilisation, and applying techniques like mixed precision, efficient data loading, and distributed training strategies (FSDP, DDP, DeepSpeed) to reduce time and cost per experiment.

  • Library development: Converting experiments into well-factored libraries with clear APIs, dependency hygiene, and versioning, so teams can import rather than copy-paste.

  • Developer Experience & Documentation: Creating templates, examples, and guidance; offering supportive, high-signal communication so others can adopt libraries confidently.

  • Reliability, Observability & Cost: Instrumenting services with metrics/logging/tracing, setting SLIs/SLOs, and optimising training and inference performance and spend.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Productionise research models: refactor, test, containerise, and integrate them into the monorepo for scalable reuse.

  • Profile and optimise PyTorch training jobs, working with researchers to identify bottlenecks across compute, memory, I/O, and networking.

  • Improve distributed training setups (multi-GPU, multi-node) and help teams pick the right parallelism strategy for their workload.

  • Build and maintain inference services, SDKs, and shared libraries that standardise pre/post-processing and interfaces across variants.

  • Create multi-variant runners and rollout frameworks (feature flags, canaries, A/B testing, automated rollbacks).

  • Establish CI/CD workflows, artifact management, and reproducible builds for ML services and model assets.

  • Add robust observability (dashboards, alerts) and reliability practices (load tests, chaos/resiliency checks) across training and inference workloads.

  • Optimise inference (batching, caching, quantisation/compilation, hardware utilisation) to reduce latency and cost.

  • Work across the broader training stack, including Kubernetes orchestration, storage (e.g. Weka, Vast, Lustre), and data pipelines, to remove friction for research teams.

  • Partner with researchers and product engineers via code reviews, pair sessions, and clear documentation to accelerate adoption.

  • Drive good engineering hygiene in the research codebase: testing strategy, dependency management, and de-duplication across multiple model variants.

You're probably a match if you:

  • Have strong software engineering fundamentals and excellent Python skills; you're comfortable turning notebooks and prototypes into production-grade services.

  • Have shipped ML systems in production (containers, APIs, CI/CD), ideally within a monorepo environment.

  • Have hands-on experience optimising PyTorch training or inference, profiling workloads, and reasoning about GPU memory, compute, and throughput.

  • Are comfortable in containerised environments and understand Kubernetes concepts well enough to debug and improve ML workloads running on it.

  • Can read research code and refactor it into clean abstractions with stable, well-documented interfaces.

  • Understand service reliability and observability (metrics, tracing, logging) and how they apply to ML systems.

  • Think holistically about the stack, from storage and networking through to model code, and can hold a credible conversation with researchers, DevOps, and platform engineers alike.

  • Communicate clearly and empathetically, especially when guiding others to adopt libraries and best practices and mentoring engineers earlier in their ML journey.

  • Bring cloud experience (AWS a plus) without needing to be a deep specialist.

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with model-serving/optimisation tooling (e.g., ONNX, TorchScript, Triton, quantisation).

  • Experience writing or optimising CUDA kernels, or using compilation frameworks (torch.compile, Triton, TensorRT) to speed up models.

  • Experience with distributed training frameworks (FSDP, DDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron) at meaningful scale.

  • Familiarity with high-performance storage systems (Weka, Vast, Lustre) and the data loading patterns that make or break training throughput.

  • Experience with experimentation platforms (feature flags, A/B testing) and safe rollout strategies.

  • Background with multimodal/image generation stacks or LLM-adjacent tooling (not the core focus, but helpful).

  • Knowledge of MLOps practices (model registries, artifact stores, dependency/version management).

Impact you'll have:

You'll dramatically reduce the time it takes to move from a successful experiment to a reliable, observable feature in production. You'll eliminate copy-paste, unify interfaces, enable parallel variants, and build the shared foundations that let Canva ship ML innovation at scale. You'll also help our research teams get more out of every GPU hour, making training faster and inference cheaper as we scale up the work CORE is doing.
